quotes.quote: Anyone who thinks sitting in church can make you a Christian must also think that sitting in a garage can make you a car.
quotes.author: Garrison Keillor

quotes.quote: The great gift of Easter is hope - Christian hope which makes us have that confidence in God, in his ultimate triumph, and in his goodness and love, which nothing can shake.
quotes.author: Basil Hume

quotes.quote: Optimism is the faith that leads to achievement. Nothing can be done without hope and confidence.
quotes.author: Helen Keller

quotes.quote: Always be yourself, express yourself, have faith in yourself, do not go out and look for a successful personality and duplicate it.
quotes.author: Bruce Lee

quotes.quote: There's plenty of room for humor in politics, God knows, but it's a serious business.
quotes.author: Al Franken

quotes.quote: The measure of a man is not how great his faith is, but how great his love is. We must not let government programs disconnect our souls from each other.
quotes.author: J. C. Watts

quotes.quote: The Christian life is not a constant high. I have my moments of deep discouragement. I have to go to God in prayer with tears in my eyes, and say, 'O God, forgive me,' or 'Help me.'
quotes.author: Billy Graham

quotes.quote: The foundation stones for a balanced success are honesty, character, integrity, faith, love and loyalty.
quotes.author: Zig Ziglar

quotes.quote: God has a most wicked sense of humor.
quotes.author: Maureen O'Hara

quotes.quote: I am a firm believer that God has already ordered the things that have taken place in my life... and I'm just learning to follow the path he's laid before me.
quotes.author: Monica Denise Brown

quotes.quote: I always say you can never be extravagant with beauty. Beauty is God made real. Beauty is life.
quotes.author: Imelda Marcos

quotes.quote: I certainly didn't say while writing 'Gossip Girl,' 'Oh this is going to be big!' It was really like, 'Oh god, everyone's gong to hate these people! They're so bratty!' But I actually think what is so appealing about them is the humor in them.
quotes.author: Cecily von Ziegesar

quotes.quote: God intended Earth. God intended the waters. God intended you and me. We were created in the image and the likeness of God; we are holograms, if you will. So the power, the presence, the energy is within you and me. The energy of God, as life, is within each of us.
quotes.author: Mary Manin Morrissey

quotes.quote: When I work, and in my art, I hold hands with God.
quotes.author: Robert Mapplethorpe

quotes.quote: I liked the humor of it, I've always enjoyed a sense of humor in God and in religion and in spirituality.
quotes.author: Amber Tamblyn

quotes.quote: I hope to God that the inner strength that will vindicate my deeds will in good time spring forth from my own people. I have done as I had to on the prompting of my inner voice.
quotes.author: Kurt Huber

quotes.quote: Never trust anyone completely but God. Love people, but put your full trust only in God.
quotes.author: Lawrence Welk

quotes.quote: I believe in Christianity as I believe that the sun has risen: not only because I see it, but because by it I see everything else.
quotes.author: C.S. Lewis

quotes.quote: A person once asked me, in a provocative manner, if I approved of homosexuality. I replied with another question: 'Tell me: when God looks at a gay person, does he endorse the existence of this person with love, or reject and condemn this person?' We must always consider the person.
quotes.author: Pope Francis

quotes.quote: A great city, whose image dwells in the memory of man, is the type of some great idea. Rome represents conquest; Faith hovers over the towers of Jerusalem; and Athens embodies the pre-eminent quality of the antique world, Art.
quotes.author: Benjamin Disraeli

quotes.quote: Hope is the word which God has written on the brow of every man.
quotes.author: Victor Hugo

quotes.quote: What gives me the most hope every day is God's grace; knowing that his grace is going to give me the strength for whatever I face, knowing that nothing is a surprise to God.
quotes.author: Rick Warren

quotes.quote: As you walk in God's divine wisdom, you will surely begin to see a greater measure of victory and good success in your life.
quotes.author: Joseph Prince

quotes.quote: The roles of art, morality, religion, political faith, science itself are not to repair organic exhaustion nor to provide sound functioning of the organs. All this supraphysical life is built and expanded not because of the demands of the cosmic environment but because of the demands of the social environment.
quotes.author: Emile Durkheim

quotes.quote: I am a bit of a hopeless romantic. I really do have a faith and a belief in love, and when I love, I love hard.
quotes.author: Melanie Fiona

quotes.quote: When I stand before God at the end of my life, I would hope that I would not have a single bit of talent left, and could say, 'I used everything you gave me'.
quotes.author: Erma Bombeck

quotes.quote: Brazil is where I belong, the place that feels like home. They love their family, their country and God, and are not afraid to let anybody know it.
quotes.author: Dionne Warwick

quotes.quote: To love means loving the unlovable. To forgive means pardoning the unpardonable. Faith means believing the unbelievable. Hope means hoping when everything seems hopeless.
quotes.author: Gilbert K. Chesterton

quotes.quote: God never promised us a trouble-free life.
quotes.author: Joyce Meyer

quotes.quote: There is hope for the future because God has a sense of humor and we are funny to God.
quotes.author: Bill Cosby

quotes.quote: Our worldly successes cannot be guaranteed, but our ability to achieve spiritual success is entirely up to us, thanks to the grace of God. The best advice I know is to give is to give those worldly things your best but never your all - reserve the ultimate hope for the only one who can grant it.
quotes.author: Mitt Romney

quotes.quote: Some people don't understand the promises they're making when they make them,"I said."Right, of course. But you keep the promise anyway. That's what love is. Love is keeping the promise anyway.
quotes.author: John Green,  The Fault in Our Stars

quotes.quote: The things that have always been important: to be a good man, to try to live my life the way God would have me, to turn it over to Him that His will might be worked in my life, to do my work without looking back, to give it all I've got, and to take pride in my work as an honest performer.
quotes.author: Johnny Cash

quotes.quote: In this life struggle, here I am among you fully cognizant that a true believer has no fear of what God has ordained for him. Those who are visited by fear live only for their present, under the illusion that the world began with them and will end with their departure.
quotes.author: King Hussein I

quotes.quote: One of my defining beliefs is that Jesus Christ has taken all of my guilt before God, and that he has been raised from the dead. That gives incredible hope and meaning to every day of my life - that nothing done in this world is wasted when it's done for him and his glory, and that there will be a day of justice and reward for the entire world.
quotes.author: Joshua Harris

quotes.quote: Art and Religion are, then, two roads by which men escape from circumstance to ecstasy. Between aesthetic and religious rapture there is a family alliance. Art and Religion are means to similar states of mind.
quotes.author: Clive Bell

quotes.quote: Someday, after mastering the winds, the waves, the tides and gravity, we shall harness for God the energies of love, and then, for a second time in the history of the world, man will have discovered fire.
quotes.author: Pierre Teilhard de Chardin

quotes.quote: My mother told me, 'Son, nobody else but God knows.' And that's what I'm about - reaching out to the people, crying with them, giving them hope. Visiting the hospital, visiting the kids with cancer, visiting the adults, and stuff like that. That's what I do.
quotes.author: Mr. T

quotes.quote: A baby is God's opinion that life should go on.
quotes.author: Carl Sandburg

quotes.quote: Religion is the everlasting dialogue between humanity and God. Art is its soliloquy.
quotes.author: Franz Werfel

quotes.quote: God proved His love on the Cross. When Christ hung, and bled, and died, it was God saying to the world, 'I love you.'
quotes.author: Billy Graham

quotes.quote: Nature is the art of God.
quotes.author: Dante Alighieri

quotes.quote: Over the years I've learned how to lock myself up in a prison of hope, knowing that God has nothing but His best planned for me. He promised me things concerning my ministry and my life.
quotes.author: Joyce Meyer

quotes.quote: I hope for the day when everyone can speak again of God without embarrassment.
quotes.author: Paul Tillich

quotes.quote: God wants us to know that life is a series of beginnings, not endings. Just as graduations are not terminations, but commencements. Creation is an ongoing process, and when we create a perfect world where love and compassion are shared by all, suffering will cease.
quotes.author: Bernie Siegel

quotes.quote: I've always had a sick sense of humor, and I've always wanted that to permeate the music because I don't take myself seriously. I take the music seriously, but I know I'm not God's gift to anyone except my mom.
quotes.author: Josh Homme

quotes.quote: All God does is watch us and kill us when we get boring. We must never, ever be boring.
quotes.author: Chuck Palahniuk,  Invisible Monsters

quotes.quote: Love, hope, fear, faith - these make humanity; These are its sign and note and character.
quotes.author: Robert Browning

quotes.quote: Art, as far as it is able, follows nature, as a pupil imitates his master; thus your art must be, as it were, God's grandchild.
quotes.author: Dante Alighieri

quotes.quote: I really do believe that God is love, one of deep affection and grace and forgiveness and inspiration.
quotes.author: William P. Young

quotes.quote: A lot of people say, 'Hey, God doesn't have a sense of humor.' Yes, He does. God has a great sense of humor.
quotes.author: Si Robertson

quotes.quote: People don't believe or understand that a community can lose hope. You can have a whole community where hopelessness is the norm, where folks don't have faith that things will get better because history and circumstances have proven over 30, 40, or 50 years that things don't get better.
quotes.author: Geoffrey Canada

quotes.quote: God lets you be successful because he trusts you that you will do the right thing with it. Now, does he get disappointed often? All the time, because people get there and they forget how they got it.
quotes.author: Steve Harvey

quotes.quote: If we find ourselves with a desire that nothing in this world can satisfy, the most probable explanation is that we were made for another world.
quotes.author: C.S. Lewis

quotes.quote: God gives me hope that there is something greater than us, something better and bigger than the here and now, that can help us live.
quotes.author: Mattie Stepanek

quotes.quote: I think you grow wherever God plants you. I hope I'm growing as a person of faith, as a Christian. That should be our number one objective this journey of life. That all starts with a personal intimate relationship with Christ and then being in prayer every single day about all of those things - being tenacious about it.
quotes.author: J. C. Watts

quotes.quote: Men judge us by the success of our efforts. God looks at the efforts themselves.
quotes.author: Charlotte Bronte

quotes.quote: Love is the greatest gift that God has given us. It's free.
quotes.author: Taraji P. Henson

quotes.quote: I think art is the only thing that's spiritual in the world. And I refuse to forced to believe in other people's interpretations of God. I don't think anybody should be. No one person can own the copyright to what God means.
quotes.author: Marilyn Manson

quotes.quote: Religion kept some of my relatives alive, because it was all they had. If they hadn't had some hope of heaven, some companionship in Jesus, they probably would have committed suicide, their lives were so hellish.
quotes.author: Octavia Butler

quotes.quote: The art of life is to live in the present moment, and to make that moment as perfect as we can by the realization that we are the instruments and expression of God Himself.
quotes.author: Emmet Fox

quotes.quote: The Christian does not think God will love us because we are good, but that God will make us good because He loves us.
quotes.author: C.S. Lewis

quotes.quote: Hope lies in having more faith in the power of God to heal us than in the power of anything to hurt or destroy us. In realizing that as children of God we are bigger than our problems, we have the power at last to confront them.
quotes.author: Marianne Williamson

quotes.quote: They are always saying God loves us. If that's love I'd rather have a bit of kindness.
quotes.author: Graham Greene

quotes.quote: Socialism has no moral justification whatsoever; poor people are not morally superior to rich people, nor are they owed anything by rich people simply because of their lack of success. Charity is not a socialist concept - it is a religious one, an acknowledgment of God's sovereignty over property, a sovereignty the Left utterly rejects.
quotes.author: Ben Shapiro

quotes.quote: When push comes to shove, it ain't the science that's going to lift you up - it's the belief, the spiritual side of life, that's going to lift you up, no matter what religion you are.
quotes.author: Kirstie Alley

quotes.quote: Music is God's gift to man, the only art of Heaven given to earth, the only art of earth we take to Heaven.
quotes.author: Walter Savage Landor

quotes.quote: God tells me that I need to provide for my family, discipline and teach my children, and love my wife as Christ loves the church. If I don't do that, I'm being unfaithful and sinful.
quotes.author: Kevin DeYoung

quotes.quote: Hope is like peace. It is not a gift from God. It is a gift only we can give one another.
quotes.author: Elie Wiesel

quotes.quote: For God so loved the World that he gave his only Son, that whoever believes in him should not perish but have eternal life.
quotes.author: Jesus Christ

quotes.quote: You all know that I have been sustained throughout my life by three saving graces - my family, my friends, and a faith in the power of resilience and hope. These graces have carried me through difficult times and they have brought more joy to the good times than I ever could have imagined.
quotes.author: Elizabeth Edwards

quotes.quote: God grant me the courage not to give up what I think is right even though I think it is hopeless.
quotes.author: Chester W. Nimitz

quotes.quote: I think God has a sense of humor, and the way my lessons come from God is very funny. I have to laugh at myself even if it's a tough lesson.
quotes.author: Yvette Nicole Brown

quotes.quote: All things are artificial, for nature is the art of God.
quotes.author: Thomas Browne

quotes.quote: Behaving morally because of a hope of reward or a fear of punishment is not morality. Morality is not bribery or threats. Religion is bribery and threats. Humans have morality. We don't need religion.
quotes.author: Penn Jillette

quotes.quote: Success is just being happy. And I try so many different things. I do a lot of different things. Because I think God has helped me to love myself. I know who God is, and I love God.
quotes.author: Herschel Walker

quotes.quote: I was living an extremely burdensome life, because every time I prayed, I became more clearly aware of my faults. On the one hand, God was calling me. On the other, I was following the way of the world. Doing what God wanted made me happy; but I felt bound by the things of this world.
quotes.author: Saint Teresa of Avila

quotes.quote: Science without religion is lame, religion without science is blind.
quotes.author: Albert Einstein

quotes.quote: I'll tell you, in my life I've never once have seen a Hispanic panhandler, because in our community, it would be viewed as shameful to be out on the street begging. Those are all conservative values - faith, family, hard work, responsibility.
quotes.author: Ted Cruz

quotes.quote: All the world is made of faith, and trust, and pixie dust.
quotes.author: J.M. Barrie,  Peter Pan

quotes.quote: Hope, like faith, is nothing if it is not courageous; it is nothing if it is not ridiculous.
quotes.author: Thornton Wilder

quotes.quote: Every happening, great and small, is a parable whereby God speaks to us, and the art of life is to get the message.
quotes.author: Malcolm Muggeridge

quotes.quote: I believe in everything until it's disproved. So I believe in fairies, the myths, dragons. It all exists, even if it's in your mind. Who's to say that dreams and nightmares aren't as real as the here and now?
quotes.author: John Lennon

quotes.quote: Poor David Hume is dying fast, but with more real cheerfulness and good humor and with more real resignation to the necessary course of things, than any whining Christian ever dyed with pretended resignation to the will of God.
quotes.author: Adam Smith

quotes.quote: God's way of answering the Christian's prayer for more patience, experience, hope and love often is to put him into the furnace of affliction.
quotes.author: Richard Cecil

quotes.quote: I hope I never get so old I get religious.
quotes.author: Ingmar Bergman

quotes.quote: The combination of landing the biggest interview of my career and having a drill in my back reminds me that God only gives us what we can handle and that it helps to have a good sense of humor when we run smack into the absurdity of life.
quotes.author: Robin Roberts

quotes.quote: To me, it's always been a challenge to look for the light: to look for those spaces in your heart where there is hope and faith and try to embrace that rather than crush it. I've spent so many years trying to crush those feelings of hope, and I certainly succeeded for quite a while.
quotes.author: Dave Gahan

quotes.quote: If you wish to strengthen your confidence in God still more, often recall the loving way in which He has acted toward you, and how mercifully He has tried to bring you out of your sinful life, to break your attachment to the things of earth and draw you to His love.
quotes.author: Alphonsus Liguori

quotes.quote: Anytime someone says your God is ugly and you release your God and join their God, there is no hope for your freedom until you once more believe in your own concept of the 'deity.'
quotes.author: John Henrik Clarke

quotes.quote: When his life was ruined, his family killed, his farm destroyed, Job knelt down on the ground and yelled up to the heavens, "Why god? Why me?"and the thundering voice of God answered, There's just something about you that pisses me off.
quotes.author: Stephen King,  Storm of the Century: An Original Screenplay

quotes.quote: I feel like unforgiveness, bitterness and resentment, it blocks the flows of God's blessings in life.
quotes.author: Ja Rule

quotes.quote: Art is nature speeded up and God slowed down.
quotes.author: Malcolm de Chazal

quotes.quote: Faithless is he that says farewell when the road darkens.
quotes.author: J.R.R. Tolkien,  The Fellowship of the Ring

quotes.quote: Sexual living is a reflection of God's love for us. It has two key qualities, which is faithfulness and creativity of new life.
quotes.author: Vincent Nichols

quotes.quote: Didn't Lionel Richie just make a country album? No one is giving him a hard time... and God bless him - I love Lionel and should be able to do what he wants to do, like Madonna should, too. Both are having success and I applaud them. If you don't like it, don't buy it. The ageism criticism is getting old.
quotes.author: Guy Oseary

quotes.quote: I think God has a tremendous sense of humor.
quotes.author: Rainn Wilson

quotes.quote: The past is a source of knowledge, and the future is a source of hope. Love of the past implies faith in the future.
quotes.author: Stephen Ambrose

quotes.quote: The mind is its own place, and in itself can make a heaven of hell, a hell of heaven..
quotes.author: John Milton,  Paradise Lost

quotes.quote: I think if I've learned anything about friendship, it's to hang in, stay connected, fight for them, and let them fight for you. Don't walk away, don't be distracted, don't be too busy or tired, don't take them for granted. Friends are part of the glue that holds life and faith together. Powerful stuff.
quotes.author: Jon Katz

quotes.quote: Darkness comes. In the middle of it, the future looks blank. The temptation to quit is huge. Don't. You are in good company... You will argue with yourself that there is no way forward. But with God, nothing is impossible. He has more ropes and ladders and tunnels out of pits than you can conceive. Wait. Pray without ceasing. Hope.
quotes.author: John Piper

quotes.quote: I have great faith in fools - self-confidence my friends will call it.
quotes.author: Edgar Allan Poe,  Marginalia

quotes.quote: For prayer is nothing else than being on terms of friendship with God.
quotes.author: Saint Teresa of Avila

quotes.quote: I thank God I'm myself and for the life I'm given to live and for friends and lovers and beloveds, and I thank God for knowing that all those people have already paid for me.
quotes.author: Maya Angelou

quotes.quote: Art is a collaboration between God and the artist, and the less the artist does the better.
quotes.author: Andre Gide

quotes.quote: I place no hope in my strength, nor in my works: but all my confidence is in God my protector, who never abandons those who have put all their hope and thought in him.
quotes.author: Francois Rabelais

quotes.quote: God's mercy and grace give me hope - for myself, and for our world.
quotes.author: Billy Graham

quotes.quote: I think God, in creating man, somewhat overestimated his ability.
quotes.author: Oscar Wilde

quotes.quote: Prayer is not asking. It is a longing of the soul. It is daily admission of one's weakness. It is better in prayer to have a heart without words than words without a heart.
quotes.author: Mahatma Gandhi

quotes.quote: When you say a situation or a person is hopeless, you are slamming the door in the face of God.
quotes.author: Charles L. Allen

quotes.quote: The hardest people to reach with the love of God are not the bad people. They know they are bad. They have no defense. The hardest ones to win for God are the self-righteous people.
quotes.author: Charles L. Allen

quotes.quote: In this world you've just got to hope for the best and prepare for the worst and take whatever God sends.
quotes.author: Lucy Maud Montgomery

quotes.quote: Music is one of the noblest callings I can think of. It's the highest of all the art forms to me. For example, if my kid said to me, 'I want to give it all up,' whatever it is that they're doing, 'and I want to take my saxophone and go out,' I would say, 'May God go with you. This is a great and noble thing that you're doing.'
quotes.author: Hugh Laurie

quotes.quote: When I turned about 14, I developed a friendship with this guy whose mom was the secretary to Ernest Angley, the faith healer, who's very popular in the Midwest. He had a television show, and he was sort of like Liberace mixed with Jerry Falwell - very glitzy, very high-tech.
quotes.author: Marilyn Manson

quotes.quote: And now these three remain: faith, hope and love. But the greatest of these is love.
quotes.author: Anonymous,  Holy Bible: King James Version

quotes.quote: The story of Christian reformation, revival, and renaissance underscores that the darkest hour is often just before the dawn, so we should always be people of hope and prayer, not gloom and defeatism. God the Holy Spirit can turn the situation around in five minutes.
quotes.author: Os Guinness

quotes.quote: The love which moves the world, according to common Christian belief, is God's love and the love of God.
quotes.author: Mortimer Adler

quotes.quote: Art requires neither complaisance nor politeness; nothing but faith, faith and freedom.
quotes.author: Gustave Flaubert

quotes.quote: To be a Christian means to forgive the inexcusable because God has forgiven the inexcusable in you.
quotes.author: C.S. Lewis

quotes.quote: God has no religion.
quotes.author: Mahatma Gandhi

quotes.quote: Bad faith likes discourse on friendship and loyalty.
quotes.author: Mason Cooley

quotes.quote: I learned that the problems that we have are not solved by blaming somebody else, and that our hope is not in who governs us as a nation. It's not in Mitt Romney or Barack Obama or Ron Paul. Our hope is in the power of God and his gospel working in the hearts of people.
quotes.author: Kirk Cameron

quotes.quote: We are not necessarily doubting that God will do the best for us; we are wondering how painful the best will turn out to be.
quotes.author: C.S. Lewis

quotes.quote: I just hope people see that if God can do something beautiful with my broken pieces, then God truly has a plan for each and everyone of us.
quotes.author: Nick Vujicic

quotes.quote: Faith makes all things possible... love makes all things easy.
quotes.author: Dwight L. Moody

quotes.quote: God will not look you over for medals, degrees or diplomas but for scars.
quotes.author: Elbert Hubbard

quotes.quote: God gave me a second chance. I am so very glad with what is going on with my career, but I want to be a success in my relationship with my children.
quotes.author: El DeBarge

quotes.quote: We all know about love, faith, sadness, despair, hope, hopelessness, longing, desire... those are things we all have inside of us, and that's what my songs are about... what it means to be a human being.
quotes.author: Ron Pope

quotes.quote: We're all screwed up. And the way Christians mess things up is we act like we've got it going on. And if we would just stay in that place of, 'Hey, we're all screwed up and but for the grace of God, none of us have a shot here.' We need to have a sense of humor about it; that's kind of the way I've always faced my comedy.
quotes.author: Jeff Foxworthy

quotes.quote: In heaven, all the interesting people are missing.
quotes.author: Friedrich Nietzsche

quotes.quote: My mama told me in college, 'I love you, and you're God's child, but natural beauty will only take you so far.'
quotes.author: Robin Roberts

quotes.quote: Hate the sin, love the sinner.
quotes.author: Mahatma Gandhi

quotes.quote: So though there are many things I would have done differently, I submit to God's sovereignty and His purpose in my life and I thank Him that He brought me the way He brought me and gave me what He gave me when He thought I could handle it.
quotes.author: T. D. Jakes

quotes.quote: Don't compare me to Babe Ruth. God gave me the opportunity and the ability to be here at the right time, at the right moment, just like he gave Babe Ruth when he was playing. I just hope I can keep doing what I've been doing - keep taking care of business.
quotes.author: Sammy Sosa

quotes.quote: All I can do is leave it in God's hands and hope that my fans feel where I'm coming from.
quotes.author: Aaliyah

quotes.quote: If he have faith, the believer cannot be restrained. He betrays himself. He breaks out. He confesses and teaches this gospel to the people at the risk of life itself.
quotes.author: Martin Luther

quotes.quote: A man can no more diminish God's glory by refusing to worship Him than a lunatic can put out the sun by scribbling the word 'darkness' on the walls of his cell.
quotes.author: C.S. Lewis,  The Problem of Pain

quotes.quote: In a decaying society, art, if it is truthful, must also reflect decay. And unless it wants to break faith with its social function, art must show the world as changeable. And help to change it.
quotes.author: Ernst Fischer

quotes.quote: The people of Liberia know what it means to be deprived of clean water, but we also know what it means to see our children to begin to smile again with a restoration of hope and faith in the future.
quotes.author: Ellen Johnson Sirleaf

quotes.quote: Humor has always been important to me. If there is a shield of faith that you can keep up against difficulties, humor is the Teflon coating.
quotes.author: Laurel Lea

quotes.quote: A grateful heart is a beginning of greatness. It is an expression of humility. It is a foundation for the development of such virtues as prayer, faith, courage, contentment, happiness, love, and well-being.
quotes.author: James E. Faust

quotes.quote: If I should ever die, God forbid, let this be my epitaph:THE ONLY PROOF HE NEEDEDFOR THE EXISTENCE OF GODWAS MUSIC
quotes.author: Kurt Vonnegut

quotes.quote: It is perfectly possible to live a very moral life without a belief in God, and I think it's perfectly possible to live a life peppered with ill-doing and believe in God.
quotes.author: J. K. Rowling

quotes.quote: For me, 'Lamb' started out as a further exploration of the phenomenon of faith and the responsibility of a messiah that I touched on in 'Coyote Blue' and 'Island of the Sequined Love Nun,' but it ended up being an exploration of the true meaning of sacrifice, loyalty, and friendship.
quotes.author: Christopher Moore

quotes.quote: The romantic love we feel toward the opposite sex is probably one extra help from God to bring you together, but that's it. All the rest of it, the true love, is the test.
quotes.author: Joan Chen

quotes.quote: Religion and art spring from the same root and are close kin. Economics and art are strangers.
quotes.author: Nathaniel Hawthorne

quotes.quote: One of the greatest gifts we can give people is the hope that their death is nothing to fear - you know, not that it has no fear in it, but the promise of scripture is that God will lead us through the valley of the shadow of death.
quotes.author: Max Lucado

quotes.quote: Sincere friendship towards God, in all who believe him to be properly an intelligent, willing being, does most apparently, directly, and strongly incline to prayer; and it no less disposes the heart strongly to desire to have our infinitely glorious.
quotes.author: Jonathan Edwards

quotes.quote: And still, after all this time,The sun never says to the earth,"You owe Me."Look what happens withA love like that,It lights the Whole Sky.
quotes.author: HÄfez

quotes.quote: There is no surprise more magical than the surprise of being loved: It is God's finger on man's shoulder.
quotes.author: Charles Morgan

quotes.quote: Never be afraid to trust an unknown future to a known God.
quotes.author: Corrie ten Boom

quotes.quote: Science and religion are not at odds. Science is simply too young to understand.
quotes.author: Dan Brown,  Angels & Demons

quotes.quote: Hope is in the name of God, the name of our Lord Jesus Christ. Hope is when you compare your suffering to the infinite, immeasurable love and grace of God.
quotes.author: Nick Vujicic

quotes.quote: If God has made the world a perfect mechanism, He has at least conceded so much to our imperfect intellect that in order to predict little parts of it, we need not solve innumerable differential equations, but can use dice with fair success.
quotes.author: Max Born

quotes.quote: Atheism turns out to be too simple. If the whole universe has no meaning, we should never have found out that it has no meaning...
quotes.author: C.S. Lewis

quotes.quote: Sometimes beautiful things come into our lives out of nowhere. We can't always understand them, but we have to trust in them. I know you want to question everything, but sometimes it pays to just have a little faith.
quotes.author: Lauren Kate,  Torment

quotes.quote: Pain insists upon being attended to. God whispers to us in our pleasures, speaks in our consciences, but shouts in our pains. It is his megaphone to rouse a deaf world.
quotes.author: C.S. Lewis

quotes.quote: Religion is a complex and often contradictory force in our world. It fosters hope and comfort but also doubt and guilt. It creates both community and exclusion. quotes.quote: The function of prayer is not to influence God, but rather to change the nature of the one who prays.

quotes.quote: Faith is not the belief that God will do what you want. It is the belief that God will do what is right.
quotes.author: Max Lucado,  He Still Moves Stones

quotes.quote: Every man lives in two realms: the internal and the external. The internal is that realm of spiritual ends expressed in art, literature, morals, and religion. The external is that complex of devices, techniques, mechanisms, and instrumentalities by means of which we live.
quotes.author: Martin Luther King, Jr.

quotes.quote: I cannot believe in a God who wants to be praised all the time.

quotes.quote: Knock, And He'll open the doorVanish, And He'll make you shine like the sunFall, And He'll raise you to the heavensBecome nothing, And He'll turn you into everything.

quotes.quote: Religion is the masterpiece of the art of animal training, for it trains people as to how they shall think.
quotes.author: Arthur Schopenhauer

quotes.quote: I have faith that God will show you the answer. But you have to understand that sometimes it takes a while to be able to recognize what God wants you to do. That's how it often is. God's voice is usually nothing more than a whisper, and you have to listen very carefully to hear it. But other times, in those rarest of moments, the answer is obvious and rings as loud as a church bell.

quotes.quote: If you want to know what God thinks of money, just look at the people he gave it to.
quotes.author: Dorothy Parker

quotes.quote: I think faith helps me a lot. God wants you to be where He wants you to be, and that's where I want to be. If I do not get a part, I understand that maybe I needed to be home at that time, maybe in school; there's always a reason. My faith is also where my core friends are, at my church, a faith-based friendship.
quotes.author: Jason Dolley

quotes.quote: The hope of eternal life is not to be taken up upon slight grounds. It is a subject to be settled between God and your own soul; settled for eternity. A supposed hope, and nothing more, will prove your ruin.
quotes.author: Ellen G. White

quotes.quote: A truth that's told with bad intentBeats all the lies you can invent.
quotes.author: William Blake,  Auguries of Innocence

quotes.quote: As told in Friendship with God, if we simply decided to believe and act as if first, we're all one, and second, life is eternal, it would render virtually everything we've done all our lives pointless.
quotes.author: Neale Donald Walsch

quotes.quote: I hope we will not so characterize religious people as being so narrow and so biased towards people not of their own religion that they cannot even work with them in this common cause to which you say they are committed.
quotes.author: Barney Frank

quotes.quote: Simplicity, clarity, singleness: These are the attributes that give our lives power and vividness and joy as they are also the marks of great art. They seem to be the purpose of God for his whole creation.
quotes.author: Richard Holloway

quotes.quote: The darker the night, the brighter the stars,  The deeper the grief, the closer is God!
quotes.author: Fyodor Dostoyevsky,  Crime and Punishment

quotes.quote: There were times, especially when I was traveling for 'Eat, Pray, Love,' when, I swear to God, I would feel this weight of my female ancestors, all those Swedish farmwives from beyond the grave who were like, 'Go! Go to Naples! Eat more pizza! Go to India, ride an elephant! Do it! Swim in the Indian Ocean. Read those books. Learn a language.'
quotes.author: Elizabeth Gilbert

quotes.quote: Many believe - and I believe - that I have been designated for this work by God. In spite of my old age, I do not want to give it up; I work out of love for God and I put all my hope in Him.
quotes.author: Michelangelo

quotes.quote: God gave us the gift of life; it is up to us to give ourselves the gift of living well.
quotes.author: Voltaire

quotes.quote: My concern is not whether God is on our side; my greatest concern is to be on God's side, for God is always right.
quotes.author: Abraham Lincoln

quotes.quote: Isn't it enough to see that a garden is beautiful without having to believe that there are fairies at the bottom of it too?
quotes.author: Douglas Adams,  The Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy

quotes.quote: You must not lose faith in humanity. Humanity is like an ocean; if a few drops of the ocean are dirty, the ocean does not become dirty.
quotes.author: Mahatma Gandhi

quotes.quote: A mission is a place where you ask nonbelievers to come and find faith and hope and feel love.
quotes.author: Robert H. Schuller

quotes.quote: Forgive, O Lord, my little jokes on TheeAnd I'll forgive Thy great big one on me.
quotes.author: Robert Frost

quotes.quote: Children are God's Apostles, sent forth, day by day, to preach of love, and hope, and peace.
quotes.author: James Russell Lowell

quotes.quote: Make your own Bible. Select and collect all the words and sentences that in all your readings have been to you like the blast of a trumpet.
quotes.author: Ralph Waldo Emerson

quotes.quote: In the family, in interpersonal relationships, even in friendship, faith is tremendously important. If you have a partner who you believe is a good person, then it is your duty to have faith in them until the end, despite the fact that they might have done some bad things. And you have to support and believe in your children.
quotes.author: Greg Graffin

quotes.quote: Let the first act of every morning be to make the following resolve for the day:- I shall not fear anyone on Earth. - I shall fear only God. - I shall not bear ill will toward anyone. - I shall not submit to injustice from anyone. - I shall conquer untruth by truth. And in resisting untruth, I shall put up with all suffering.
quotes.author: Mahatma Gandhi

quotes.quote: Just as a mother finds pleasure in taking her little child on her lap, there to feed and caress him, in like manner our loving God shows His fondness for His beloved souls who have given themselves entirely to Him and have placed all their hope in His goodness.
quotes.author: Alphonsus Liguori

quotes.quote: Owners of dogs will have noticed that, if you provide them with food and water and shelter and affection, they will think you are god. Whereas owners of cats are compelled to realize that, if you provide them with food and water and shelter and affection, they draw the conclusion that they are gods.
quotes.author: Christopher Hitchens,  The Portable Atheist: Essential Readings for the Nonbeliever

quotes.quote: We have been given God in our souls and Christ in our flesh. We have the power to believe where others deny, to hope where others despair, to love where others hurt.
quotes.author: Brennan Manning

quotes.quote: I have had a happy life and thank the Lord. Goodbye and may God bless all!
quotes.author: Christopher McCandless

quotes.quote: He died not for men, but for each man. If each man had been the only man made, He would have done no less.
quotes.author: C.S. Lewis

quotes.quote: There are a lot of times that we feel like our hands are tied - 'I have no control over if I'm going to lose my job.' 'I have no control over if I'm going to be able to pay my bills.' You've got to realize that that's where your trust comes in. You have to trust God, and keep your hope, because your hope is what produces your faith.
quotes.author: Victoria Osteen

quotes.quote: I sought to hear the voice of God and climbed the topmost steeple, but God declared: "Go down again - I dwell among the people.
quotes.author: John Henry Newman

quotes.quote: Heard melodies are sweet, but those unheard, are sweeter
quotes.author: John Keats,  Ode on a Grecian Urn and Other Poems

quotes.quote: All I have seen teaches me to trust the Creator for all I have not seen.
quotes.author: Ralph Waldo Emerson

quotes.quote: When I do good, I feel good. When I do bad, I feel bad. That's my religion.
quotes.author: Abraham Lincoln

quotes.quote: I think a big test we all face in life on a regular basis is that discouragement test. Life's not always fair, but I believe if you keep doing the right thing, God will get you to where you are.
quotes.author: Joel Osteen

quotes.quote: The easy confidence with which I know another man's religion is folly teaches me to suspect that my own is also.
quotes.author: Mark Twain

quotes.quote: I am what I am. I love me! And I don't mean that egotistically - I love that God has allowed me to take whatever it was that I had and to make something out of it.
quotes.author: Stevie Wonder

quotes.quote: Many a sin has sullied me in body and in soul because I did not restrain my thoughts nor guard my lips: nevertheless it is to Thee, O God of majesty and love, that I turn in my extremity, for Thou art the fount of mercy; to Thee, as quickly as I may, I speed: for Thou alone canst heal me; I take refuge under Thy protection.
quotes.author: Saint Ambrose

quotes.quote: Reality TV is to popular because it allows so many people to sit on the sidelines and just watch somebody else's life. God is saying, 'Don't sit on the sidelines of life. I have put so much in you, but you have got to be strong and very courageous. You have got to step out in faith.'
quotes.author: Victoria Osteen

quotes.quote: My religion is very simple. My religion is kindness.
quotes.author: Dalai Lama XIV

quotes.quote: Parents are like God because you wanna know they're out there, and you want them to think well of you, but you really only call when you need something.
quotes.author: Chuck Palahniuk,  Invisible Monsters

quotes.quote: I believe in God, but not as one thing, not as an old man in the sky. I believe that what people call God is something in all of us. I believe that what Jesus and Mohammed and Buddha and all the rest said was right. It's just that the translations have gone wrong.
quotes.author: John Lennon

quotes.quote: I'm about to make a wild, extreme and severe relationship rule: the word busy is a load of crap and is most often used by assholes. The word "busy"is the relationship Weapon of Mass Destruction. It seems like a good excuse, but in fact in every silo you uncover, all you're going to find is a man who didn't care enough to call. Remember men are never to busy to get what they want.
quotes.author: Greg Behrendt

quotes.quote: I am a poor man and of little worth, who is laboring in that art that God has given me in order to extend my life as long as possible.
quotes.author: Michelangelo

quotes.quote: None of us knows what might happen even the next minute, yet still we go forward. Because we trust. Because we have Faith.
quotes.author: Paulo Coelho,  Brida

quotes.quote: God wants my life to be about being successful and being happy and blessing other people and being blessed.
quotes.author: Miley Cyrus

quotes.quote: Sometimes the Bible in the hand of one man is worse than a whisky bottle in the hand of (another)... There are just some kind of men who - who're so busy worrying about the next world they've never learned to live in this one, and you can look down the street and see the results.
quotes.author: Harper Lee,  To Kill a Mockingbird

quotes.quote: Life is full of happiness and tears; be strong and have faith.
quotes.author: Kareena Kapoor Khan

quotes.quote: Do not be afraid; our fateCannot be taken from us; it is a gift.
quotes.author: Dante Alighieri,  Inferno

quotes.quote: Religion is like a pair of shoes.....Find one that fits for you, but don't make me wear your shoes.
quotes.author: George Carlin

quotes.quote: Had I not come out with an inspirational CD, you perhaps would have never known that I feel like I feel, that all songs, all the music I've ever done is a gift from God.
quotes.author: Smokey Robinson

quotes.quote: Hope is some extraordinary spiritual grace that God gives us to control our fears, not to oust them.
quotes.author: Vincent McNabb

quotes.quote: Is man merely a mistake of God's? Or God merely a mistake of man?
quotes.author: Friedrich Nietzsche

quotes.quote: Sometimes God allows what he hates to accomplish what he loves.
quotes.author: Joni Eareckson Tada,  The God I Love

quotes.quote: God does not play dice with the universe; He plays an ineffable game of His own devising, which might be compared, from the perspective of any of the other players [i.e. everybody], to being involved in an obscure and complex variant of poker in a pitch-dark room, with blank cards, for infinite stakes, with a Dealer who won't tell you the rules, and who smiles all the time.
quotes.author: Terry Pratchett,  Good Omens: The Nice and Accurate Prophecies of Agnes Nutter, Witch

quotes.quote: To my young friends out there: Life can be great, but not when you can't see it. So, open your eyes to life: to see it in the vivid colors that God gave us as a precious gift to His children, to enjoy life to the fullest, and to make it count. Say yes to your life.
quotes.author: Nancy Reagan

quotes.quote: So I wanted to sing inspirational music, and that's exactly how I approached it - only the words have been changed to declare my relationship with God.
quotes.author: Smokey Robinson

quotes.quote: Science is not only compatible with spirituality; it is a profound source of spirituality.
quotes.author: Carl Sagan,  The Demon-Haunted World: Science as a Candle in the Dark

quotes.quote: I talk to God but the sky is empty.
quotes.author: Sylvia Plath

quotes.quote: God save us from people who mean well.
quotes.author: Vikram Seth,  A Suitable Boy

quotes.quote: My No. 1 focus was on my foundation, the Tim Tebow Foundation, to bring faith, hope and love to those needing a brighter day in the darkest hour of need.
quotes.author: Tim Tebow

quotes.quote: Beautiful music is the art of the prophets that can calm the agitations of the soul; it is one of the most magnificent and delightful presents God has given us.
quotes.author: Martin Luther

quotes.quote: Christian faith is... basically about love and being loved and reconciliation. These things are so important, they're foundational and they can transform individuals, families.
quotes.author: Philip Yancey

quotes.quote: I don't stand for black man's side, I don't stand for white man's side, I stand for God's side.
quotes.author: Bob Marley

quotes.quote: If I have any worth, it is to live my life for God so as to teach these peoples; even though some of them still look down on me.
quotes.author: Saint Patrick

quotes.author: Rick Riordan

quotes.quote: Next to the Word of God, the noble art of music is the greatest treasure in the world.
quotes.author: Martin Luther

quotes.quote: God our Lord would have us look to the Giver and love Him more than His gift, keeping Him always before our eyes, in our hearts, and in our thoughts.
quotes.author: Saint Ignatius

quotes.quote: I began to realize that when people experience the love of God, it casts out their fear and frees them from guilt.
quotes.author: Joseph Prince

quotes.quote: God allows us to experience the low points of life in order to teach us lessons that we could learn in no other way.
quotes.author: C.S. Lewis

quotes.quote: That wasn't any act of God. That was an act of pure human fuckery.
quotes.author: Stephen King,  The Stand

quotes.quote: The reason birds can fly and we can't is simply because they have perfect faith, for to have faith is to have wings.
quotes.author: J.M. Barrie,  The Little White Bird

quotes.quote: No woman wants to be in submission to a man who isn't in submission to God!
quotes.author: T.D. Jakes

quotes.quote: Above all else, guard your heart for it affects everything else you do.
quotes.author: Anonymous,  Holy Bible: New International Version

quotes.quote: I know now, Lord, why you utter no answer. You are yourself the answer. Before your face questions die away. What other answer would suffice?
quotes.author: C.S. Lewis

quotes.quote: Death is no more than passing from one room into another. But there's a difference for me, you know. Because in that other room I shall be able to see.
quotes.author: Helen Keller

quotes.quote: There are people in the world so hungry, that God cannot appear to them except in the form of bread.
quotes.author: Mahatma Gandhi

quotes.quote: I do know this... I seem to reach a lot of previously unchurched people. So many people have told me they never went to church until they heard our message of hope that God is a good God who desires to bless those who are faithful and obedient to Him through Jesus Christ.
quotes.author: Joel Osteen

quotes.quote: Thou hast made us for thyself, O Lord, and our heart is restless until it finds its rest in thee.
quotes.author: Augustine of Hippo,  Confessions

quotes.quote: I'm calling my book series the 'with God series.' And this next 'with God' book is Friendship with God, which comes out in November. This books challenges us to bring about the end of 'better' on this planet.
quotes.author: Neale Donald Walsch

quotes.quote: All religion, my friend, is simply evolved out of fraud, fear, greed, imagination, and poetry.
quotes.author: Edgar Allan Poe

quotes.quote: I am fundamentally an optimist. Whether that comes from nature or nurture, I cannot say. Part of being optimistic is keeping one's head pointed toward the sun, one's feet moving forward. There were many dark moments when my faith in humanity was sorely tested, but I would not and could not give myself up to despair. That way lays defeat and death.
quotes.author: Nelson Mandela,  Long Walk to Freedom: Autobiography of Nelson Mandela

quotes.quote: The God of the Old Testament is arguably the most unpleasant character in all fiction: jealous and proud of it; a petty, unjust, unforgiving control-freak; a vindictive, bloodthirsty ethnic cleanser; a misogynistic, homophobic, racist, infanticidal, genocidal, filicidal, pestilential, megalomaniacal, sadomasochistic, capriciously malevolent bully.

quotes.quote: A baby is God's opinion that the world should go on.
quotes.author: Carl Sandburg

quotes.quote: If you want to make God laugh, tell him about your plans.
quotes.author: Woody Allen

quotes.quote: Those who can make you believe absurdities, can make you commit atrocities.
quotes.author: Voltaire,  Questions sur les Miracles Ã  M. Claparede, Professeur de ThÃ©ologie Ã  GenÃ¨ve, par un Proposant: Ou Extrait de Diverses Lettres de M. de Voltaire

quotes.quote: Faith is not simply a patience that passively suffers until the storm is past. Rather, it is a spirit that bears things - with resignations, yes, but above all, with blazing, serene hope.
quotes.author: Corazon Aquino

quotes.quote: I think it pisses God off if you walk by the color purple in a field somewhere and don't notice it.
quotes.author: Alice Walker,  The Color Purple

quotes.quote: You can safely assume you've created God in your own image when it turns out that God hates all the same people you do.
quotes.author: Anne Lamott

quotes.quote: If you hope for happiness in the world, hope for it from God, and not from the world.
quotes.author: David Brainerd

quotes.quote: A casual stroll through the lunatic asylum shows that faith does not prove anything.
quotes.author: Friedrich Nietzsche

quotes.quote: He - and if there is a God, I am convinced he is a he, because no woman could or would ever fuck things up this badly.
quotes.author: George Carlin

quotes.quote: There's so much to be grateful for, words are poor things.
quotes.author: Marilynne Robinson,  Home

quotes.quote: And God help Bruce Springsteen when they decide he's no longer God... They'll turn on him, and I hope he survives it.
quotes.author: John Lennon

quotes.quote: I'm so single. It's funny. I'm usually a relationship girl. I love being in love and having a partner in crime. But it's good to be your own partner in crime. God, that makes me sound like I have multiple-personality disorder.
quotes.author: Brittany Snow

quotes.quote: Among my friends, I'm not a little Boy Scout, and they love my humor, thank God.
quotes.author: Don Rickles

quotes.quote: I know why I am here and my only real focused goal is to live each day to the fullest and to try and honor God and be an encouragement to others. What the future holds is firmly in God's hands, and I am very happy about that!
quotes.author: Ken Hensley

quotes.quote: God is silent. Now if only man would shut up.
quotes.author: Woody Allen

quotes.quote: Yes, reason has been a part of organized religion, ever since two nudists took dietary advice from a talking snake.
quotes.author: Jon Stewart

quotes.quote: I have lost my seven best friends, which is to say God has had mercy on me seven times without realizing it. He lent a friendship, took it from me, sent me another.
quotes.author: Jean Cocteau

quotes.quote: Throughout life people will make you mad, disrespect you and treat you bad. Let God deal with the things they do, cause hate in your heart will consume you too.
quotes.author: Will Smith

quotes.quote: People, I thought, wanted security. They couldn't bear the idea of death being a big black nothing, couldn't bear the thought of their loved ones not existing, and couldn't even imagine themselves not existing. I finally decided that people believed in an afterlife because they couldn't bear not to.
quotes.author: John Green,  Looking for Alaska

quotes.quote: Faith is love taking the form of aspiration.
quotes.author: William Ellery Channing

quotes.quote: Look for God, suggests my Guru. Look for God like a man with his head on fire looks for water.
quotes.author: Elizabeth Gilbert

quotes.quote: I'm completely in favor of the separation of Church and State. ... These two institutions screw us up enough on their own, so both of them together is certain death.
quotes.author: George Carlin

quotes.quote: I thank you God for this most amazing day, for the leaping greenly spirits of trees, and for the blue dream of sky and for everything which is natural, which is infinite, which is yes.
quotes.author: e. e. cummings

quotes.quote: Sometimes we may ask God for success, and He gives us physical and mental stamina. We might plead for prosperity, and we receive enlarged perspective and increased patience, or we petition for growth and are blessed with the gift of grace. He may bestow upon us conviction and confidence as we strive to achieve worthy goals.
quotes.author: David A. Bednar

quotes.quote: God has already done everything He's going to do. The ball is now in your court. If you want success, if you want wisdom, if you want to be prosperous and healthy, you're going to have to do more than meditate and believe; you must boldly declare words of faith and victory over yourself and your family.
quotes.author: Joel Osteen

quotes.quote: Believe in a love that is being stored up for you like an inheritance, and have faith that in this love there is a strength and a blessing so large that you can travel as far as you wish without having to step outside it.
quotes.author: Rainer Maria Rilke,  Letters to a Young Poet

quotes.quote: When you do what you fear most, then you can do anything.
quotes.author: Stephen Richards

quotes.quote: What was love, really? Flowers, chocolate, and poetry? Or was it something else? Was it being able to finish someone's jokes? Was it having absolute faith that someone was there at your back? Was it knowing someone so well that they instantly understood why you did the things you did--and shared those same beliefs?
quotes.author: Richelle Mead,  Last Sacrifice

quotes.quote: The possession of knowledge does not kill the sense of wonder and mystery. There is always more mystery.
quotes.author: AnaÃ¯s Nin

quotes.quote: The legitimate powers of government extend to such acts only as are injurious to others. It does me no injury for my neighbor to say there are twenty gods or no god. It neither picks my pocket nor breaks my leg.
quotes.author: Thomas Jefferson

quotes.quote: Testimony is an integral part of the Black religious tradition. It is the occasion where the believer stands before the community of faith in order to give account of the hope that is in him or her.
quotes.author: James Hal Cone

quotes.quote: Just as a candle cannot burn without fire, men cannot live without a spiritual life.
quotes.author: Buddha

quotes.quote: I'm most proud of the blessings that God has bestowed upon me, in my life. He's given me the vision to truly see that you can fall down, but you can still get back up. Hopefully I'll learn from my mistakes and have the opportunity to strengthen and improve the next thing I do.
quotes.author: Martin Lawrence

quotes.quote: The great thing to remember is that though our feelings come and go God's love for us does not.
quotes.author: C.S. Lewis

quotes.quote: I can see how it might be possible for a man to look down upon the earth and be an atheist, but I cannot conceive how a man could look up into the heavens and say there is no God.
quotes.author: Abraham Lincoln

quotes.quote: For me, it is far better to grasp the Universe as it really is than to persist in delusion, however satisfying and reassuring.
quotes.author: Carl Sagan,  The Demon-Haunted World: Science as a Candle in the Dark

quotes.quote: From faith, hope, and love, the virtues of religion referring to God, there arises a double act which bears on the spiritual communion exercised between God and us; the hearing of the word and prayer.
quotes.author: William Ames

quotes.quote: You can never really know someone completely. That's why it's the most terrifying thing in the world, really--taking someone on faith, hoping they'll take you on faith too. It's such a precarious balance, It's a wonder we do it at all. And yet..
quotes.author: Libba Bray

quotes.quote: Properly read, the Bible is the most potent force for atheism ever conceived.
quotes.author: Isaac Asimov

quotes.quote: And out of that hopeless attempt has come nearly all that we call human history--money, poverty, ambition, war, prostitution, classes, empires, slavery--the long terrible story of man trying to find something other than God which will make him happy.
quotes.author: C.S. Lewis,  Mere Christianity

quotes.quote: People tell you the world looks a certain way. Parents tell you how to think. Schools tell you how to think. TV. Religion. And then at a certain point, if you're lucky, you realize you can make up your own mind. Nobody sets the rules but you. You can design your own life.
quotes.author: Carrie-Anne Moss

quotes.quote: Religion is excellent stuff for keeping common people quiet. Religion is what keeps the poor from murdering the rich.
quotes.author: NapolÃ©on Bonaparte

quotes.quote: Is God willing to prevent evil, but not able? Then he is not omnipotent. Is he able, but not willing? Then he is malevolent. Is he both able and willing? Then whence cometh evil? Is he neither able nor willing? Then why call him God?
quotes.author: Epicurus

quotes.quote: I think it's perfectly possible to explain how the universe came about without bringing God into it, but I don't know everything, and there may well be a God somewhere, hiding away. Actually, if he is keeping out of sight, it's because he's ashamed of his followers and all the cruelty and ignorance they're responsible for promoting in his name. If I were him, I'd want nothing to do with them.
quotes.author: Philip Pullman

quotes.quote: Of all human activities, man's listening to God is the supreme act of his reasoning and will.
quotes.author: Pope Paul VI

quotes.quote: I believe in good and evil,"said Jem. "And I believe the soul is eternal. But I don't believe in the fiery pit, the pitchforks, or endless torment. I do not believe you can threaten people into goodness."Tessa looked at will. "What about you? What do you believe?"Pulvis et umbra sumus,"said Will, not looking at her as he spoke. "I believe we are dust and shadows. What else is there?
quotes.author: Cassandra Clare,  Clockwork Angel

quotes.quote: My argument against God was that the universe seemed so cruel and unjust. But how had I got this idea of just and unjust? A man does not call a line crooked unless he has some idea of a straight line. What was I comparing this universe with when I called it unjust?
quotes.author: C.S. Lewis,  Mere Christianity

quotes.quote: Atheism is more than just the knowledge that gods do not exist, and that religion is either a mistake or a fraud. Atheism is an attitude, a frame of mind that looks at the world objectively, fearlessly, always trying to understand all things as a part of nature.
quotes.author: Emmett F. Fields

quotes.quote: I have never made but one prayer to God, a very short one: Oh Lord, make my enemies ridiculous. And God granted it."(Letter to Ã‰tienne NoÃ«l Damilaville, May 16, 1767)
quotes.author: Voltaire

quotes.quote: Our heavenly Father understands our disappointment, suffering, pain, fear, and doubt. He is always there to encourage our hearts and help us understand that He's sufficient for all of our needs. When I accepted this as an absolute truth in my life, I found that my worrying stopped.
quotes.author: Charles Stanley

quotes.quote: It is easy enough to be friendly to one's friends. But to befriend the one who regards himself as your enemy is the quintessence of true religion. The other is mere business.

quotes.quote: Forgive the past. It is over. Learn from it and let go. People are constantly changing and growing. Do not cling to a limited, disconnected, negative image of a person in the past. See that person now. Your relationship is always alive and changing.

quotes.quote: I dont think that we're meant to understand it all the time. I think that sometimes we just have to have faith.

quotes.quote: The Christian ideal has not been tried and found wanting. It has been found difficult; and left untried.
quotes.author: G.K. Chesterton,  What's Wrong with the World

quotes.quote: If this is going to be a Christian nation that doesn't help the poor, either we have to pretend that Jesus was just as selfish as we are, or we've got to acknowledge that He commanded us to love the poor and serve the needy without condition and then admit that we just don't want to do it.

quotes.quote: In this hour, I do not believe that any darkness will endure.

quotes.quote: Religion. It's given people hope in a world torn apart by religion.

quotes.quote: Doubt everything. Find your own light.

quotes.author: Corrie ten Boom,  The Hiding Place

quotes.quote: Do not wait for the last judgment. It comes every day.

quotes.author: Christopher Hitchens

quotes.quote: I do not believe in God and I am not an atheist.

quotes.quote: Extraordinary claims require extraordinary evidence.
quotes.author: Carl Sagan

quotes.quote: Young man, the secret of my success is that an early age I discovered that I was not God.

quotes.quote: It is when we notice the dirt that God is most present in us; it is the very sign of His presence.

quotes.quote: A single day is enough to make us a little larger or, another time, a little smaller.
quotes.author: Paul Klee

quotes.quote: Joy is the infallible sign of the presence of God.

quotes.quote: Dear God! how beauty varies in nature and art. In a woman the flesh must be like marble; in a statue the marble must be like flesh.

quotes.quote: In all of living, have much fun and laughter. Life is to be enjoyed, not just endured.

quotes.quote: If there were such a thing as terminal literalism, you'd have died in childhood.
quotes.author: Cassandra Clare,  City of Bones

quotes.quote: This is my simple religion. No need for temples. No need for complicated philosophy. Your own mind, your own heart is the temple. Your philosophy is simple kindness.

quotes.author: Charles M. Schulz

quotes.quote: Your children are the greatest gift God will give to you, and their souls the heaviest responsibility He will place in your hands. Take time with them, teach them to have faith in God. quotes.quote: The Kingdom is the love of God prevailing in politics, in business, in government, in media. It is all the impact of the laws of God creating a social environment where the strong help the weak, where those who have give to those who don't. It's a society where relationships are built on love.
quotes.author: Myles Munroe

quotes.quote: Man suffers only because he takes seriously what the gods made for fun.
quotes.author: Alan W. Watts

quotes.quote: I don't deserve a soul, yet I still have one. I know because it hurts.
quotes.author: Douglas Coupland,  The Gum Thief

quotes.quote: I have no idea what's awaiting me, or what will happen when this all ends. For the moment I know this: there are sick people and they need curing.
quotes.author: Albert Camus,  The Plague

quotes.quote: All that you touchYou Change.All that you ChangeChanges you.The only lasting truthis Change.Godis Change.
quotes.author: Octavia E. Butler

quotes.quote: Quit questioning God and start trusting Him!
quotes.author: Joel Osteen

quotes.quote: Love meant jumping off a cliff and trusting that a certain person would be there to catch you at the bottom.
quotes.author: Jodi Picoult,  Second Glance

quotes.quote: The dog is a gentleman; I hope to go to his heaven not man's.
quotes.author: Mark Twain

quotes.quote: belief is the death of intelligence.
quotes.author: Robert Anton Wilson,  Cosmic Trigger: Die letzten Geheimnisse der Illuminaten oder An den Grenzen des erweiterten Bewusstseins

quotes.quote: You do not need to know precisely what is happening, or exactly where it is all going. What you need is to recognize the possibilities and challenges offered by the present moment, and to embrace them with courage, faith and hope.

quotes.quote: The great moral powers of the soul are faith, hope, and love.

quotes.quote: Faith is about doing. You are how you act, not just how you believe.

quotes.quote: God answers all prayers, but sometimes his answer is 'no'.
quotes.author: Dan Brown,  Angels & Demons

quotes.quote: We know that God is everywhere; but certainly we feel His presence most when His works are on the grandest scale spread before us; and it is in the unclouded night-sky, where His worlds wheel their silent course, that we read clearest His infinitude, His omnipotence, His omnipresence.

quotes.quote: Human decency is not derived from religion. It precedes it.
quotes.author: Christopher Hitchens,  God Is Not Great: How Religion Poisons Everything

quotes.quote: No man can be called friendless who has God and the companionship of good books.
quotes.author: Elizabeth Barrett Browning

quotes.quote: How many observe Christ's birthday! How few, His precepts!
quotes.author: Benjamin Franklin

quotes.quote: If Jesus came back and saw what was being done in his name, he'd never stop throwing up.
quotes.author: Woody Allen,  Hannah and Her Sisters

quotes.quote: The greatest legacy one can pass on to one's children and grandchildren is not money or other material things accumulated in one's life, but rather a legacy of character and faith.
quotes.author: Billy Graham

quotes.quote: There is not enough love and goodness in the world to permit giving any of it away to imaginary beings.
quotes.author: Friedrich Nietzsche,  Human, All Too Human

quotes.quote: Follow your bliss and the universe will open doors for you where there were only walls.

quotes.quote: I do not feel obliged to believe that the same God who has endowed us with sense, reason, and intellect has intended us to forgo their use.

I'm like, 'Oh, my God, you should read To Kill a Mockingbird.'
quotes.author: John Krasinski

quotes.quote: Independence is my happiness, and I view things as they are, without regard to place or person; my country is the world, and my religion is to do good.
quotes.author: Thomas Paine,  Rights of Man

quotes.quote: I have been driven many times upon my knees by the overwhelming conviction that I had no where else to go. My own wisdom and that of all about me seemed insufficient for that day.
quotes.author: Abraham Lincoln

quotes.quote: Some things have to be believed to be seen.
quotes.author: Madeleine L'Engle

quotes.quote: Faith is walking face-first and full-speed into the dark. If we truly knew all the answers in advance as to the meaning of life and the nature of God and the destiny of our souls, our belief would not be a leap of faith and it would not be a courageous act of humanity; it would just be... a prudent insurance policy.
quotes.author: Elizabeth Gilbert

quotes.quote: I wore black because I liked it. I still do, and wearing it still means something to me. It's still my symbol of rebellion -- against a stagnant status quo, against our hypocritical houses of God, against people whose minds are closed to others' ideas.

quotes.quote: I have as much authority as the Pope. I just don't have as many people who believe it.

quotes.quote: I can tell you from experience that God's help and presence in our lives is vital. He is the Author of all true success and everything that is good-without Him, we can do nothing of true value.
quotes.author: Joyce Meyer

quotes.author: C.S. Lewis,  The Lion, the Witch, and the Wardrobe

quotes.quote: Even though you can't expect to defeat the absurdity of the world, you must make the attempt. That's morality, that's religion, that's art, that's life.

quotes.quote: Yes, the long war on Christianity. I pray that one day we may live in an America where Christians can worship freely! In broad daylight! Consecutively.

quotes.quote: I try to make my life about service, and hope that one day we can all 'see' a little better because God is with everyone and everywhere.

quotes.quote: I feel I am lucky. I am grateful for this life that God has given me. I am happy, as I am getting to do work that I want to do and enjoy doing it.

CALVIN:Yeah, but actually, I've got the same questions about God.

quotes.author: Mother Teresa

quotes.quote: I challenge anyone to understand Islam, its spirit, and not to love it. It is a beautiful religion of brotherhood and devotion.
quotes.author: Yann Martel,  Life of Pi

quotes.quote: God's Final Message to His Creation:'We apologize for the inconvenience.
quotes.author: Douglas Adams,  So Long, and Thanks for All the Fish

quotes.quote: We may ignore, but we can nowhere evade the presence of God. The world is crowded with Him. He walks everywhere incognito.
quotes.author: C.S. Lewis

quotes.quote: Down on the lake rosy reflections of celestial vapor appeared, and I said, "God, I love you"and looked to the sky and really meant it. "I have fallen in love with you, God. Take care of us all, one way or the other."To the children and the innocent it's all the same.
quotes.author: Jack Kerouac,  The Dharma Bums

quotes.quote: How hurtful it can be to deny one's true self and live a life of lies just to appease others.
quotes.author: June Ahern

quotes.quote: When you get to the end of all the light you know and it's time to step into the darkness of the unknown, faith is knowing that one of two things shall happen: either you will be given something solid to stand on, or you will be taught how to fly.

quotes.quote: We are all connected; To each other, biologically. To the earth, chemically. To the rest of the universe atomically.
quotes.author: Neil deGrasse Tyson

quotes.quote: It takes three to make love, not two: you, your spouse, and God. Without God people only succeed in bringing out the worst in one another. Lovers who have nothing else to do but love each other soon find there is nothing else. Without a central loyalty life is unfinished.
