quotes.quote: God had brought me to my knees and made me acknowledge my own nothingness, and out of that knowledge I had been reborn. I was no longer the centre of my life and therefore I could see God in everything.
quotes.author: Bede Griffiths

quotes.quote: We are saved by faith alone, but the faith that saves is never alone.
quotes.author: Martin Luther

quotes.quote: If we can just let go and trust that things will work out they way they're supposed to, without trying to control the outcome, then we can begin to enjoy the moment more fully. The joy of the freedom it brings becomes more pleasurable than the experience itself.
quotes.author: Goldie Hawn

quotes.quote: I live and love in God's peculiar light.
quotes.author: Michelangelo

quotes.quote: Why is there ever this perverse cruelty in humankind, that makes us hurt most those we love best?
quotes.author: Jacqueline Carey,  Kushiel's Chosen

quotes.quote: I seem to have run in a great circle, and met myself again on the starting line.
quotes.author: Jeanette Winterson,  Oranges Are Not the Only Fruit

quotes.quote: To dream by night is to escape your life. To dream by day is to make it happen.
quotes.author: Stephen Richards

quotes.quote: God is a concept by which we measure our pain.
quotes.author: John Lennon

quotes.quote: I don't know how you feel, but I'm pretty sick of church people. You know what they ought to do with churches? Tax them. If holy people are so interested in politics, government, and public policy, let them pay the price of admission like everybody else. The Catholic Church alone could wipe out the national debt if all you did was tax their real estate.
quotes.author: George Carlin

quotes.quote: Dare to love yourselfas if you were a rainbowwith gold at both ends.
quotes.author: Aberjhani,  Journey through the Power of the Rainbow: Quotations from a Life Made Out of Poetry

quotes.quote: When one person suffers from a delusion, it is called insanity. When many people suffer from a delusion it is called a Religion.
quotes.author: Robert M. Pirsig,  Zen and the Art of Motorcycle Maintenance: An Inquiry Into Values

quotes.quote: Work without love is slavery.
quotes.author: Mother Teresa

quotes.quote: Do you think it's possible for an entire nation to be insane?
quotes.author: Terry Pratchett,  Monstrous Regiment

quotes.quote: The moment God is figured out with nice neat lines and definitions, we are no longer dealing with God.
quotes.author: Rob Bell,  Velvet Elvis: Repainting the Christian Faith

quotes.quote: I'm not afraid of death because I don't believe in it.It's just getting out of one car, and into another.
quotes.author: John Lennon

quotes.quote: To have faith is to trust yourself to the water. When you swim you don't grab hold of the water, because if you do you will sink and drown. Instead you relax, and float.
quotes.author: Alan W. Watts

quotes.quote: What you are is God's gift to you, what you become is your gift to God.
quotes.author: Hans Urs von Balthasar,  Prayer

quotes.quote: What comes into our minds when we think about God is the most important thing about us.
quotes.author: A.W. Tozer

quotes.quote: If there is any religion that could respond to the needs of modern science, it would be Buddhism.
quotes.author: Albert Einstein

quotes.quote: To be rejected by someone doesn't mean you should also reject yourself or that you should think of yourself as a lesser person. It doesn't mean that nobody will ever love you anymore. Remember that only ONE person has rejected you at the moment, and it only hurt so much because to you, that person's opinion symbolized the opinion of the whole world, of God.
quotes.author: Jocelyn Soriano,  Mend My Broken Heart

quotes.quote: One of the things I learned the hard way was that it doesn't pay to get discouraged. Keeping busy and making optimism a way of life can restore your faith in yourself.
quotes.author: Lucille Ball

quotes.quote: One of the most spiritual things you can do is embrace your humanity. Connect with those around you today. Say, "I love you", "I'm sorry", "I appreciate you", "I'm proud of you"...whatever you're feeling. Send random texts, write a cute note, embrace your truth and share it...cause a smile today for someone else...and give plenty of hugs.
quotes.author: Steve Maraboli

quotes.quote: Religious liberty might be supposed to mean that everybody is free to discuss religion. In practice it means that hardly anybody is allowed to mention it.
quotes.author: G.K. Chesterton

quotes.quote: Relying on God has to begin all over again every day as if nothing had yet been done.
quotes.author: C.S. Lewis,  Letters to Malcolm: Chiefly on Prayer

quotes.quote: Well, while you were in the bathroom, I sat down at this picnic table here in Bumblefug, Kentucky, and noticed that someone had carved that GOD HATES FAG, which, aside from being a grammatical nightmare, is absolutely ridiculous. So I'm changing it to 'God Hates Baguettes.' It's tough to disagree with that. Everybody hates baguettes.
quotes.author: John Green,  An Abundance of Katherines

quotes.quote: No, I would not want to live in a world without dragons, as I would not want to live in a world without magic, for that is a world without mystery, and that is a world without faith.
quotes.author: R.A. Salvatore,  Streams of Silver

quotes.quote: Laws and principles are not for the times when there is no temptation: they are for such moments as this, when body and soul rise in mutiny against their rigour ... If at my convenience I might break them, what would be their worth?
quotes.author: Charlotte BrontÃ«,  Jane Eyre

quotes.quote: You made me confess the fears that I have. But I will tell you also what I do not fear. I do not fear to be alone or to be spurned for another or to leave whatever I have to leave. And I am not afraid to make a mistake, even a great mistake, a lifelong mistake and perhaps as long as eternity too.
quotes.author: James Joyce,  A Portrait of the Artist as a Young Man

quotes.quote: We almost made it to thirty seconds without an insult. I think we set a new record.
quotes.author: Sherrilyn Kenyon,  Acheron

quotes.quote: You were made by God and for God and until you understand that, life will never make sense.
quotes.author: Rick Warren

quotes.quote: It was my duty to shoot the enemy, and I don't regret it. My regrets are for the people I couldn't save: Marines, soldiers, buddies. I'm not naive, and I don't romanticize war. The worst moments of my life have come as a SEAL. But I can stand before God with a clear conscience about doing my job.
quotes.author: Chris Kyle

quotes.quote: There is but one good; that is God. Everything else is good when it looks to Him and bad when it turns from Him.
quotes.author: C.S. Lewis,  The Great Divorce

quotes.quote: Imagine there's no countriesIt isn't hard to doNothing to kill or die forAnd no religion tooImagine all the peopleLiving life in peaceYou may say that I'm a dreamerBut I'm not the only oneI hope someday you'll join usAnd the world will be as one
quotes.author: John Lennon,  Imagine

quotes.quote: I cannot imagine a God who rewards and punishes the objects of his creation, whose purposes are modeled after our own -- a God, in short, who is but a reflection of human frailty. Neither can I believe that the individual survives the death of his body, although feeble souls harbor such thoughts through fear or ridiculous egotisms.
quotes.author: Albert Einstein

quotes.quote: Souls cross ages like clouds cross skies, an' tho' a cloud's shape nor hue nor size don't stay the same, it's still a cloud an' so is a soul. Who can say where the cloud's blowed from or who the soul'll be 'morrow? Only Sonmi the east an' the west an' the compass an' the atlas, yay, only the atlas o' clouds.
quotes.author: David Mitchell,  Cloud Atlas

quotes.quote: I'm not bothered about what people say behind my back. I don't need to know about it. I believe in living my life and doing my work. God will give you success. And even if He doesn't, there's a lesson to be learnt.
quotes.author: Rani Mukerji

quotes.quote: If a dog doesn't put you first where are you both? In what relation? A dog needs God. It lives by your glances, your wishes. It even shares your humor. This happens about the fifth year. If it doesn't happen you are only keeping an animal.
quotes.author: Enid Bagnold

quotes.quote: Better to sleep with a sober cannibal than a drunk Christian.
quotes.author: Herman Melville,  Moby-Dick; or, The Whale

quotes.quote: The irony is that while God doesn't need us but still wants us, we desperately need God but don't really want Him most of the time.
quotes.author: Francis Chan

quotes.quote: Believe there is a great power silently working all things for good, behave yourself and never mind the rest.
quotes.author: Beatrix Potter

quotes.quote: You are someone who is different, but who wants to be the same as everyone else. And that in my view is a serious illness. God chose you to be different. Why are you disappointing God with this kind of attitude?
quotes.author: Paulo Coelho,  Veronika Decides to Die

quotes.quote: The president of the United States has claimed, on more than one occasion, to be in dialogue with God. If he said that he was talking to God through his hairdryer, this would precipitate a national emergency. I fail to see how the addition of a hairdryer makes the claim more ridiculous or offensive.
quotes.author: Sam Harris,  Letter to a Christian Nation

quotes.quote: Sometimes you can see things happen right in front of your eyes and still jump to the wrong conclusions.
quotes.author: Jodi Picoult,  Keeping Faith

quotes.quote: You will face your greatest opposition when you are closest to your biggest miracle.
quotes.author: Shannon L. Alder

quotes.quote: I believe in intuitions and inspirations...I sometimes FEEL that I am right. I do not KNOW that I am.
quotes.author: Albert Einstein

quotes.author: G.K. Chesterton

quotes.quote: I tremble for my country when I hear of confidence expressed in me. I know too well my weakness, that our only hope is in God.

quotes.author: Arnold Bennett

quotes.quote: The real question of life after death isn't whether or not it exists, but even if it does what problem this really solves.

quotes.quote: All religions are true but none are literal.

quotes.quote: The greatest act of faith some days is to simply get up and face another day.
quotes.author: Amy Gatliff

quotes.quote: My soul doth magnify the Lord,And my spirit hath rejoiced in God my Saviour.
quotes.author: Mary (mother of Jesus),  Holy Bible: King James Version

quotes.quote: Go where your best prayers take you.
quotes.author: Frederick Buechner

quotes.author: Ezra Taft Benson

quotes.quote: I have so much to do that I shall spend the first three hours in prayer.

quotes.quote: Persistence. Perfection. Patience. Power. Prioritize your passion. It keeps you sane.

quotes.author: Ray Manzarek

quotes.quote: Prejudice, a dirty word, and faith, a clean one, have something in common: they both begin where reason ends.

quotes.quote: when we are powerless to do a thing, it is a great joy that we can come and step inside the ability of Jesus

quotes.quote: You are not your body. You are the sum of all your actions, and they live on after your body dies. You may be mortal, but your brand is eternal.

quotes.author: John Piper,  Don't Waste Your Life Study Guide

quotes.quote: Once upon a time, I dreamt I was a butterfly, fluttering hither and thither, to all intents and purposes a butterfly. I was conscious only of my happiness as a butterfly, unaware that I was myself. Soon I awaked, and there I was, veritably myself again. Now I do not know whether I was then a man dreaming I was a butterfly, or whether I am now a butterfly, dreaming I am a man.
quotes.author: Zhuangzi,  The Butterfly as Companion: Meditations on the First Three Chapters of the Chuang-Tzu

When people are fanatically dedicated to political or religious faiths or any other kinds of dogmas or goals, it's always because these dogmas or goals are in doubt.
quotes.author: Robert M. Pirsig,  Zen and the Art of Motorcycle Maintenance: An Inquiry Into Values

quotes.quote: When every hope is gone, 'when helpers fail and comforts flee,' I find that help arrives somehow, from I know not where. Supplication, worship, prayer are no superstition; they are acts more real than the acts of eating, drinking, sitting or walking. It is no exaggeration to say that they alone are real, all else is unreal.
quotes.author: Mahatma Gandhi,  The Story of My Experiments With Truth

quotes.quote: God sleeps in the minerals, awakens in plants, walks in animals, and thinks in man.
quotes.author: Arthur Young

quotes.quote: Happiness is the object and design of our existence; and will be the end thereof, if we pursue the path that leads to it; and this path is virtue, uprightness, faithfulness, holiness, and keeping all the commandments of God.
quotes.author: Joseph Smith Jr.

quotes.quote: A sense of humour is the only divine quality of man

quotes.quote: Every day people are straying away from the church and going back to God.

quotes.quote: A preoccupation with the next world clearly shows an inability to cope credibly with this one.
quotes.author: Richard K. Morgan,  Broken Angels

quotes.quote: People are never so completely and enthusiastically evil as when they act out of religious conviction.

quotes.quote: Imagination is the voice of daring. If there is anything godlike about God, it is that. He dared to imagine everything

quotes.quote: People who cease to believe in God or goodness altogether still believe in the devil... Evil is always possible. And goodness is eternally difficult.
quotes.author: Anne Rice,  Interview with the Vampire

quotes.quote: Good works is giving to the poor and the helpless, but divine works is showing them their worth to the One who matters.
quotes.author: Criss Jami,  Killosophy

quotes.quote: When everything gets answered, it's fake.
quotes.author: Sean Penn

quotes.quote: You are not what others think you are. You are what God knows you are.
quotes.author: Shannon L. Alder

quotes.quote: If I knew what you'd do, exactly when you knew what you'd do, then I'd either be you or I'd be God. And we both know I'm not you.
quotes.author: Jarod Kintz,  This is the best book I've ever written, and it still sucks

quotes.quote: I think it is safe to say that while the South is hardly Christ-centered, it is most certainly Christ-haunted.
quotes.author: Flannery O'Connor

quotes.quote: You are one thing only. You are a Divine Being. An all-powerful Creator. You are a Deity in jeans and a t-shirt, and within you dwells the infinite wisdom of the ages and the sacred creative force of All that is, will be and ever was.
quotes.author: Anthon St. Maarten,  Divine Living: The Essential Guide To Your True Destiny

quotes.quote: The spiritual life does not remove us from the world but leads us deeper into it
quotes.author: Henri J.M. Nouwen

quotes.quote: I used to wonder if it was God's plan that I should be alone for so much of my life. But I found peace. I found happiness within people and the world.
quotes.author: Lana Del Rey

quotes.quote: It's so hard to believe in anything anymore. I mean, it's like, religion, you really can't take it seriously, because it seems so mythological, it seems so arbitrary...but, on the other hand, science is just pure empiricism, and by virtue of its method, it excludes metaphysics. I guess I wouldn't believe in anything anymore if it weren't for my lucky astrology mood watch.
quotes.author: Steve Martin

quotes.quote: I don't try to imagine a personal God; it suffices to stand in awe at the structure of the world, insofar as it allows our inadequate senses to appreciate it.
quotes.author: Albert Einstein

quotes.quote: If every trace of any single religion were wiped out and nothing were passed on, it would never be created exactly that way again. There might be some other nonsense in its place, but not that exact nonsense. If all of science were wiped out, it would still be true and someone would find a way to figure it all out again.
quotes.author: Penn Jillette,  God, No!: Signs You May Already Be an Atheist and Other Magical Tales

quotes.quote: The Bible is not my book nor Christianity my profession. I could never give assent to the long, complicated statements of Christian dogma.
quotes.author: Abraham Lincoln,  Speeches and Writings, 1832-1858

quotes.quote: All this twaddle, the existence of God, atheism, determinism, liberation, societies, death, etc., are pieces of a chess game called language, and they are amusing only if one does not preoccupy oneself with 'winning or losing this game of chess.
quotes.author: Marcel Duchamp

quotes.quote: When someone you love says goodbye you can stare long and hard at the door they closed and forget to see all the doors God has open in front of you.
quotes.author: Shannon L. Alder

quotes.quote: It is a fine thing to establish one's own religion in one's heart, not to be dependent on tradition and second-hand ideals. Life will seem to you, later, not a lesser, but a greater thing.
quotes.author: D.H. Lawrence

quotes.quote: Forgiveness is God's greatest gift
quotes.author: Dan Brown,  The Da Vinci Code

quotes.quote: The word I think of is precarious. I am struck by how precarious it all is. How the things that hold us are only as strong as the faith we have in them.

quotes.quote: Extraordinary afflictions are not always the punishment of extraordinary sins, but sometimes the trial of extraordinary graces.
quotes.author: Matthew Henry,  Matthew Henry's Commentary on the Whole Bible

quotes.quote: I contend that we are both atheists. I just believe in one fewer god than you do. When you understand why you dismiss all the other possible gods, you will understand why I dismiss yours.
quotes.author: Stephen Roberts

quotes.quote: See? This is why I'm not religious. I couldn't possibly keep my mouth shut long enough to get along with everyone else.
quotes.author: Jim Butcher,  White Night

quotes.quote: Hearing nuns' confessions is like being stoned to death with popcorn.
quotes.author: Fulton J. Sheen

quotes.quote: Wait on the Lord"is a constant refrain in the Psalms, and it is a necessary word, for God often keeps us waiting. He is not in such a hurry as we are, and it is not his way to give more light on the future than we need for action in the present, or to guide us more than one step at a time. When in doubt, do nothing, but continue to wait on God. When action is needed, light will come.

quotes.quote: Unless there is a Good Friday in your life, there can be no Easter Sunday.
quotes.author: Fulton J. Sheen

quotes.quote: The spiritualization of sensuality is called love: it is a great triumph over Christianity.
quotes.author: Friedrich Nietzsche

quotes.quote: It's all God's will: you can die in your sleep, and God can spare you in battle.

quotes.quote: Let the world know what you live for...not what you fall for!
quotes.author: John Paul Warren

quotes.quote: Don't believe in God. Love the world just the way it is.
quotes.author: Melina Marchetta,  On the Jellicoe Road

quotes.quote: If Jesus Christ were to come today, people would not even crucify him. They would ask him to dinner, and hear what he had to say, and make fun of it.

quotes.quote: It turned out I was pretty good in science. But again, because of the small budget, in science class we couldn't afford to do experiments in order to prove theories. We just believed everything. Actually, I think that class was called Religion. Religion class was always an easy class. All you had to do was suspend the logic and reasoning you were being taught in all the other classes.

quotes.quote: God dwells within you, as you.

quotes.quote: Quiet the mind, and the soul will speak.

quotes.quote: I want to write a book so long that it will take the average person their whole life to read. It will be exactly the same length as the Bible.
quotes.author: Jarod Kintz,  I Want

quotes.quote: Whatever God requires is right, no matter what it is, although we may not see the reason there of until all of the events transpire.
quotes.author: Joseph Smith Jr.

quotes.quote: Let nothing disturb you,Let nothing frighten you,All things are passing away:God never changes.Patience obtains all things.Whoever has God lacks nothing;God alone suffices.
quotes.author: Teresa of Ãvila

quotes.quote: He who has God and everything else has no more than he who has God only.
quotes.author: C.S. Lewis,  The Weight of Glory

quotes.quote: Contrary to what you may assume, I am not a pessimist but an indifferentist- that is, I don't make the mistake of thinking that the... cosmos... gives a damn one way or the other about the especial wants and ultimate welfare of mosquitoes, rats, lice, dogs, men, horses, pterodactyls, trees, fungi, dodos, or other forms of biological energy.
quotes.author: H.P. Lovecraft

quotes.quote: If you violate laws of God, you're a sinner.If you violate laws of men, you're a criminal.If you violate your own laws, you're pathetic.
quotes.author: Toba Beta,  Master of Stupidity

quotes.quote: You're here to be light, bringing out the God-colors in the world.(Matthew 5:14, The Message)
quotes.author: Anonymous,  The Message Remix

quotes.quote: The grace of God means something like: Here is your life. You might never have been, but you are because the party wouldn't have been complete without you.
quotes.author: Frederick Buechner

quotes.quote: Our hearts of stone become hearts of flesh when we learn where the outcast weeps.

quotes.quote: gray hair is gods graffiti

quotes.quote: If absolute power corrupts absolutely, where does that leave God?
quotes.author: George Deacon

quotes.quote: If you can see the invisible, God will do the impossible.

quotes.quote: I hope and trust the infinite, the eternal, and merciful and loving God. I worship Him and feel no guilt in my heart before him for what I am going to do.
quotes.author: Alex Campbell

quotes.quote: In the darkness, he is invisible, but I can still feel him beside me. Sometimes you don't have to see something to know it is there.
quotes.author: Maggie Stiefvater,  Forever

People of the world!""Well, if you put it that way, I think you've got a point. Have another biscuit, sorry.
quotes.author: Eddie Izzard,  Glorious

quotes.quote: I find the whole business of religion profoundly interesting. But it does mystify me that otherwise intelligent people take it seriously.

quotes.author: Brennan Manning,  Souvenirs of Solitude: Finding Rest in Abba's Embrace

quotes.quote: But very quickly they all became grave again: for, as you know, there is a kind of happiness and wonder that makes you serious. It is too good to waste on jokes.

quotes.quote: Restlessness and impatience change nothing except our peace and joy. Peace does not dwell in outward things, but in the heart prepared to wait trustfully and quietly on Him who has all things safely in His hands.
quotes.author: Elisabeth Elliot

quotes.quote: You're gonna have to serve somebody; well, it may be the devil, or it may be the Lord, but you're gonna have to serve somebody...
quotes.author: Bob Dylan

Even if things are so tangled up you can't do anything, don't get desperate or blow a fuse and start yanking on one particular thread before it's ready to come undone. You have to realize it's going to be along process and that you'll work on things slowly, one at a time.
quotes.author: Haruki Murakami,  Norwegian Wood

quotes.quote: These people walk by a widow deformed by leprosy...walk by children dressed in rags living in the street, and they think, 'Business as usual.' But if they perceive a slight against God, it is a different story. Their faces go red, their chests heave mightily, they sputter angry words. The degree of their indignation is astonishing. Their resolve is frightening.
quotes.author: Yann Martel,  Life of Pi

quotes.quote: Talk to me about the truth of religion and I'll listen gladly. Talk to me about the duty of religion and I'll listen submissively. But don't come talking to me about the consolations of religion or I shall suspect that you don't understand.
quotes.author: C.S. Lewis,  A Grief Observed

quotes.quote: Spirituality is not to be learned by flight from the world, or by running away from things, or by turning solitary and going apart from the world. Rather, we must learn an inner solitude wherever or with whomsoever we may be. We must learn to penetrate things and find God there.
quotes.author: Meister Eckhart

quotes.author: Hanh Nhat Thich,  Peace Is Every Step: The Path of Mindfulness in Everyday Life

quotes.quote: Faith is an oasis in the heart which will never be reached by the caravan of thinking.
quotes.author: Kahlil Gibran

quotes.quote: Spirituality is recognizing and celebrating that we are all inextricably connected to each other by a power greater than all of us, and that our connection to that power and to one another is grounded in love and compassion. quotes.author: BrenÃ© Brown,  The Gifts of Imperfection: Let Go of Who You Think You're Supposed to Be and Embrace Who You Are

quotes.author: Joyce Meyer

quotes.quote: When your back is to the wall and you are facing fear head on, the only way is forward and through it.
quotes.author: Stephen Richards,  Releasing You from Fear

quotes.quote: The purpose of all the major religious traditions is not to construct big temples on the outside, but to create temples of goodness and compassion inside, in our hearts.
quotes.author: Dalai Lama XIV

quotes.quote: Love is the only future God offers.
quotes.author: Victor Hugo,  Les MisÃ©rables

quotes.author: Henry Wadsworth Longfellow

quotes.author: Stephen King

quotes.author: M.E. Thomas,  Confessions of a Sociopath: A Life Spent Hiding in Plain Sight

quotes.quote: You are never alone. You are eternally connected with everyone.

quotes.quote: It is not about doing what we feel like. It is about doing what God says.

Selfish people are hard to love because so little love comes out of them.

quotes.quote: On the Disc, the Gods aren't so much worshipped, as they are blamed.

quotes.quote: Faith is not so much something we believe; faith is something we live.

quotes.quote: Give me the storm and tempest of thought and action, rather than the dead calm of ignorance and faith! Banish me from Eden when you will; but first let me eat of the fruit of the tree of knowledge!
quotes.author: Robert G. Ingersoll,  The Works Of Robert G. Ingersoll, Vol. Iii

quotes.quote: There is no religion without love, and people may talk as much as they like about their religion, but if it does not teach them to be good and kind to man and beast, it is all a sham.
quotes.author: Anna Sewell,  Black Beauty

quotes.quote: Eskimo: "If I did not know about God and sin, would I go to hell?"Priest: "No, not if you did not know."Eskimo: "Then why did you tell me?
quotes.author: Annie Dillard

quotes.quote: If it can be verified, we don't need faith... Faith is for that which lies on the other side of reason. Faith is what makes life bearable, with all its tragedies and ambiguities and sudden, startling joys.
quotes.author: Madeleine L'Engle

quotes.quote: A man who is intimate with God is not intimidated by man.
quotes.author: Leonard Ravenhill

quotes.quote: If I say your voice is an amber waterfall in which I yearn to burn each day, if you eat my mouth like a mystical rose with powers of healing and damnation, If I confess that your body is the only civilization I long to experience... would it mean that we are close to knowing something about love?
quotes.author: Aberjhani,  Visions of a Skylark Dressed in Black

quotes.quote: The take-home message is that we should blame religion itself, not religious extremism - as though that were some kind of terrible perversion of real, decent religion. quotes.quote: I plead with you--never, ever give up on hope, never doubt, never tire, and never become discouraged. Be not afraid.
quotes.author: Pope John Paul II,  Pope John Paul II: In My Own Words

quotes.quote: It is the Holy Spirit's job to convict, God's job to judge and my job to love.
quotes.author: Billy Graham

quotes.quote: I have always strenuously supported the right of every man to his own opinion, however different that opinion might be to mine. He who denies to another this right, makes a slave of himself to his present opinion, because he precludes himself the right of changing it.

quotes.quote: Language is the key to the heart of people.
quotes.author: Ahmed Deedat

quotes.quote: You should read something else."Why would he have done that to him?"I don't know,"she said.Do you ever feel like Job?"She smiled, a little twinkle in her eyes.Sometimes."But you haven't lost your faith?"No,"I knew she hadn't, but I think I was losing mine.Is it because you think you might get better?"No,"she said,"its because its the only thing I have left.
quotes.author: Nicholas Sparks

quotes.quote: If money's the god people worship, I'd rather go worship the devil instead.
quotes.author: Jess C. Scott,  Rockstar

quotes.quote: It's faith in something and enthusiasm for something that makes a life worth living.
quotes.author: Oliver Wendell Holmes Sr.

quotes.quote: Understanding is the reward of faith. Therefore, seek not to understand that you may believe, but believe that you may understand.
quotes.author: Augustine of Hippo

quotes.quote: To truly try means to accept God's love, his healing, to accept the world can be ugly, but your heart doesn't have to be. It takes courage, Finley the warrior. "But so is God's love and so are those arms he's holding out for you.

quotes.author: Samuel Taylor Coleridge,  The Rime of the Ancient Mariner

quotes.quote: Faith in God includes Faith in God's timing.

Nontheism is relaxing with the ambiguity and uncertainty of the present moment without reaching for anything to protect ourselves.

quotes.quote: If God is for us, who can be against us?

quotes.author: Cesar Chavez

quotes.quote: I do know that waiting on God requires the willingness to bear uncertainty, to carry within oneself the unanswered question, lifting the heart to God about it whenever it intrudes upon one's thoughts. Its easy to talk oneself into a decision that has no permanence - easier sometimes than to wait patiently.

quotes.quote: I try to deny myself any illusions or delusions, and I think that this perhaps entitles me to try and deny the same to others, at least as long as they refuse to keep their fantasies to themselves.

quotes.quote: A celibate clergy is an especially good idea, because it tends to suppress any hereditary propensity toward fanaticism.

quotes.quote: Confidence is like a dragon where, for every head cut off, two more heads grow back.
quotes.author: Criss Jami,  Venus in Arms

quotes.quote: There is no justice in love, no proportion in it, and there need not be, because in any specific instance it is only a glimpse or parable of an embracing, incomprehensible reality. quotes.author: Marilynne Robinson,  Gilead

quotes.author: John Bytheway,  When Times Are Tough: 5 Scriptures That Will Help You Get Through Almost Anything

quotes.quote: Reality provides us with facts so romantic that imagination itself could add nothing to them.
quotes.author: Jules Verne

quotes.quote: The power of God is with you at all times; through the activities of mind, senses, breathing, and emotions; and is constantly doing all the work using you as a mere instrument.
quotes.author: Anonymous,  Bhagavad Gita: El Canto del Senor

quotes.quote: I am a religious person, although I am not a believer.

quotes.quote: Self-observation is the first step of inner unfolding.

quotes.author: Christopher Hitchens,  The Portable Atheist: Essential Readings for the Nonbeliever

quotes.quote: But for me the sweetest contact with God has no form. I close my eyes, look within, and enter a deep soft silence. The infinity of God's creation embraces me.

They use my name as if I spent my entire days sitting on their shoulders, forcing them to commits acts they would otherwise find repulsive. 'The devil made me do it.' quotes.author: Neil Gaiman,  The Sandman, Vol. 4: Season of Mists

quotes.author: Veronica Roth,  Divergent

quotes.quote: Christians are hard to tolerate; I don't know how Jesus does it

quotes.author: Jarod Kintz,  American Association for the Advancement of Aardvarks Presents: Dear Natalie

quotes.quote: Sometimes I think it is my mission to bring faith to the faithless, and doubt to the faithful.

quotes.quote: To be commanded to love God at all, let alone in the wilderness, is like being commanded to be well when we are sick, to sing for joy when we are dying of thirst, to run when our legs are broken. But this is the first and great commandment nonetheless. Even in the wilderness - especially in the wilderness - you shall love him.

quotes.quote: Care more for a grain of faith than a ton of excitement.

quotes.quote: Fear is the glue that keeps you stuck. Faith is the solvent that sets you free.

quotes.quote: I think it is very good when people suffer. To me that is like the kiss of Jesus.

quotes.quote: Perfect prayer does not consist in many words, silent remembering and pure intention raises the heart to that supreme Power.

quotes.quote: To have found God and still to pursue Him is the soul's paradox of love.

quotes.author: Mark Twain

quotes.author: Oswald Chambers,  My Utmost for His Highest Journal

quotes.quote: We have never heard the devil's side of the story, God wrote all the book.
quotes.author: Anatole France

Nevertheless, that person is the only one responsible for his or her actions along the way and has no right to shift responsibility for any personal decisions on to that religion.

quotes.author: Henry Miller

quotes.author: Fulton J. Sheen,  Seven Words of Jesus and Mary: Lessons from Cana and Calvary

quotes.author: Mikhail Bakunin

quotes.quote: Trust and faith bring joy to life and help relationships grow to their maximum potential.
quotes.author: Joyce Meyer,  Battlefield of the Mind: Winning the Battle in Your Mind

quotes.quote: There once was a time when all people believed in God and the church ruled. This time was called the Dark Ages.
quotes.author: Richard Lederer,  Anguished English: An Anthology of Accidental Assaults Upon Our Language

quotes.quote: You and your purpose in life are the same thing. Your purpose is to be you.
quotes.author: George Alexiou

quotes.quote: I was taught to strive not because there were any guarantees of success but because the act of striving is in itself the only way to keep faith with life.
quotes.author: Madeleine Albright,  Madam Secretary: A Memoir

quotes.quote: Faith is like radar that sees through the fog -- the reality of things at a distance that the human eye cannot see.
quotes.author: Corrie ten Boom

quotes.quote: Your heart's strength is measured by how hard it holds on. Your self worth and faith is measured by finally letting go. However, your peace is measured by how long you don't look back.
quotes.author: Shannon L. Alder

quotes.quote: So India's problem turns out to be the world's problem. What happened in India has happened in God's name.The problem's name is God.
quotes.author: Salman Rushdie,  The Satanic Verses

quotes.quote: Even God has a hell: his love of Mankind.
quotes.author: Paulo Coelho,  The Devil and Miss Prym

quotes.quote: True faith rests upon the character of God and asks no further proof than the moral perfections of the One who cannot lie.
quotes.author: A.W. Tozer

quotes.quote: 'Shoot the wounded... what we do to people who are the most vulnerable... we 'shoot the wounded.' As if they haven't suffered enough, we add to it by gossiping and treating hurt people like outcasts."..."I think we killed Ronnie's spirit... Instead of coming alongside her and supporting her through this, I failed her...
quotes.author: Lynn Dove,  Shoot the Wounded

quotes.quote: No matter how many people believe or don't believe in you, you must bethe ultimate believer in yourself!
quotes.author: Pablo

quotes.quote: Life is doubt,And faith without doubt is nothing but death.
quotes.author: Miguel de Unamuno

quotes.quote: Not all dreamers are winners, but all winners are dreamers. Your dream is the key to your future. The Bible says that, "without a vision (dream), a people perish."You need a dream, if you're going to succeed in anything you do.
quotes.author: Mark Gorman

quotes.quote: A few songs with Him might change the way you sing. Forever.
quotes.author: Max Lucado,  Next Door Savior

quotes.quote: Thank God men cannot fly, and lay waste the sky as well as the earth.
quotes.author: Henry David Thoreau

quotes.quote: I rather spend every Sunday of my life hanging off a cliff to rescue someone than spend one more time sitting in a pew next to hypocrites that talk about what they will do to better themselves and the world when they get around to it.
quotes.author: Shannon L. Alder

quotes.quote: Religious moderation is the product of secular knowledge and scriptural ignorance.
quotes.author: Sam Harris,  The End of Faith: Religion, Terror, and the Future of Reason

quotes.quote: Most world religions denounced war as a barbaric waste of human life. We treasured the teachings of these religions so dearly that we frequently had to wage war in order to impose them on other people.
quotes.author: Jon Stewart

quotes.quote: Receive with simplicity everything that happens to you.
quotes.author: Rashi

quotes.quote: My people are going to learn the principles of democracy the dictates of truth and the teachings of science. Superstition must go. Let them worship as they will, every man can follow his own conscience provided it does not interfere with sane reason or bid him act against the liberty of his fellow men.
quotes.author: Mustafa Kemal AtatÃ¼rk

quotes.quote: The tempter or the tempted, who sins most?
quotes.author: William Shakespeare,  Measure for Measure

quotes.quote: There are few things more dangerous than inbred religious certainty.
quotes.author: Bart D. Ehrman,  God's Problem: How the Bible Fails to Answer Our Most Important Question - Why We Suffer

quotes.quote: What can you say to a man who tells you he prefers obeying God rather than men, and that as a result he's certain he'll go to heaven if he cuts your throat?
quotes.author: Voltaire,  Philosophical Dictionary

quotes.quote: The more humble and obedient to God a man is, the more wise and at peace he will be in all that he does.
quotes.author: Thomas Ã  Kempis,  The Inner Life

quotes.quote: All religions are equally sublime to the ignorant, useful to the politician, and ridiculous to the philosopher.
quotes.author: Titus Lucretius Carus,  On the Nature of Things: de Rerum Natura

quotes.quote: God rewards those who seek Him. Not those who seek doctrine of religion or systems or creeds. Many settle for these lesser passions, but the reward goes to those who settle for nothing less than Jesus himself. And what is the reward? What awaits those who seek Jesus? Nothing short of the heart of Jesus.
quotes.author: Max Lucado,  Just Like Jesus

quotes.quote: The Holy Land is everywhere
quotes.author: Black Elk

quotes.quote: Every night I pray I whisper into a megaphone, not only so God is sure to hear, but also my neighbors, because I pray to God He'll deliver pestilence and plague to the residents next door. quotes.quote: The greatest enemy of hunger for God is not poison but apple pie.It is not the banquet of the wicked that dulls our appetite forheaven, but endless nibbling at the table of the world. It is notthe X-rated video, but the prime-time dribble of triviality wedrink in every night.
quotes.author: John Piper,  A Hunger for God

quotes.quote: Every religion is true one way or another. It is true when understood metaphorically. But when it gets stuck in its own metaphors, interpreting them as facts, then you are in trouble.
quotes.author: Joseph Campbell

quotes.quote: You are free; you are free to go to your temples. You are free to go to your mosques or to any other places of worship in this State of Pakistan. You may belong to any religion, caste or creed--that has nothing to do with the business of the state.
quotes.author: Muhammad Ali Jinnah

quotes.quote: It's not about finding ways to avoid God's judgment and feeling like a failure if you don't do everything perfectly. It's about fully experiencing God's love and letting it perfect you. It's not about being somebody you are not. It's about becoming who you really are.
quotes.author: Stormie Omartian,  The Power of a Praying Woman

quotes.quote: The soul hardly ever realizes it, but whether he is a believer or not, his loneliness is really a homesickness for God.
quotes.author: Hubert Van Zeller

quotes.quote: Faith does not need to push the river because faith is able to trust that there is a river. The river is flowing. We are in it.
quotes.author: Richard Rohr

quotes.quote: Did God ever cry over his lost angel, I wonder?
quotes.author: Libba Bray,  Rebel Angels

quotes.quote: Choices will continually be necessary and -- let us not forget -- possible. Obedience to God is always possible. It is a deadly error to fall into the notion that when feelings are extremely strong we can do nothing but act on them.
quotes.author: Elisabeth Elliot,  Discipline: The Glad Surrender

quotes.quote: Pray, hope, and don't worry. Worry is useless. God is merciful and will hear your prayer.
quotes.author: Padre Pio

quotes.quote: Out of 100 men, one will read the Bible, the other 99 will read the Christian.
quotes.author: D.L. Moody

quotes.quote: If there is anything that links the human to the divine, it is the courage to stand by a principle when everybody else rejects it.
quotes.author: Abraham Lincoln

quotes.quote: Take all that you can of this book upon reason, and the balance on faith, and you will live and die a happier man. (When a skeptic expressed surprise to see him reading a Bible)
quotes.author: Abraham Lincoln

quotes.quote: If God exists, I hope he has a good excuse.
quotes.author: Woody Allen

quotes.quote: Faith, the least exclusive club on Earth, has the craftiest doorman. Every time I've stepped through its wide-open doorway, I find myself stepping out on the street again.
quotes.author: David Mitchell,  Cloud Atlas

quotes.quote: The invisible and the non-existent look very much alike.
quotes.author: Delos McKown

quotes.quote: What comes, is called.
quotes.author: Ki Longfellow,  Flow Down Like Silver: Hypatia of Alexandria

quotes.quote: In the beginning God created the heavens and the earth.

quotes.quote: We can never know who or what we are till we know at least something of what God is.
quotes.author: A.W. Tozer

quotes.quote: It was all very well going on about pure logic and how the universe was ruled by logic and the harmony of numbers, but the plain fact of the matter was that the Disc was manifestly traversing space on the back of a giant turtle and the gods had a habit of going round to atheists' houses and smashing their windows.
quotes.author: Terry Pratchett,  The Color of Magic

quotes.quote: The Way is not in the sky; the Way is in the heart.
quotes.author: Gautama Buddha

quotes.quote: Un-winged and naked, sorrow surrenders its crown to a throne called grace.

quotes.quote: It sometimes takes a state of solitude to bring to mind the real power of companionship.
quotes.author: Stephen Richards

quotes.quote: I learned that the search for God is a Dark Night, that Faith is a Dark Night. And that's hardly a surprise really, because for us each day is a dark night. None of us knows what might happen even the next minute, and yet still we go forward. Because we trust. Because we have Faith.

quotes.quote: Man is the most insane species. He worships an invisible God and destroys a visible Nature. Unaware that this Nature he's destroying is this God he's worshiping.

quotes.author: Ann Voskamp,  One Thousand Gifts: A Dare to Live Fully Right Where You Are

quotes.quote: If you gave [Jerry] Falwell an enema he could be buried in a matchbox.

quotes.quote: Compassion crowns the soul with its truest victory.

quotes.quote: I regard the afterlife to be a fairy story for people that are afraid of the dark

quotes.quote: Reason is in fact the path to faith, and faith takes over when reason can say no more.

quotes.author: Mary Daly

quotes.quote: Men take care not to make women weep, for God counts their tears.
quotes.author: Thomas S. Monson

quotes.quote: Only God is awesome.
quotes.author: Shane Claiborne

quotes.author: Carl Sagan,  Contact

quotes.quote: I couldn't get Him out of my head. Still can't. I spent three solid days thinking about Him. The more He bothered me, the less I coul forget Him. And the more I learned about Him, the less I wanted to leave Him.

quotes.quote: Therefore, since we are receiving a kingdom that cannot be shaken, let us be thankful, and so worship God acceptably with reverence and awe, for our God is a consuming fire.

quotes.author: Jarod Kintz,  This Book is Not FOR SALE

quotes.quote: Since Alice had never received any religious instruction, and since she had led a blameless life, she never thought of her awful luck as being anything but accidents in a very busy place. Good for her.
quotes.author: Kurt Vonnegut,  Slapstick or Lonesome No More!

quotes.quote: Religion begins in story. Yes, it does, because religion is an attempt to make sense of what is incomprehensible to us, what is inexplicable, what is awe-inspiring, what is frightening, what moves us to great wonder, and so on. That is the religious impulse, and it is part of our psychological makeup -- of everyone's psychological makeup.
quotes.author: Philip Pullman

quotes.quote: Too many people get credit for being good, when they are only being passive. They are too often praised for being broadminded when they are so broadminded they can never make up their minds about anything.
quotes.author: Fulton J. Sheen

quotes.quote: The heart is like a woman, and the head is like a man, and although man is the head of woman, woman is the heart of man, and she turns man's head because she turns his heart.
quotes.author: Peter Kreeft,  Jesus-Shock

quotes.author: Anonymous,  Holy Bible: King James Version

quotes.quote: The idea of God, infinity, or spirit stands for the possible attempt at an impossible conception.
quotes.author: Edgar Allan Poe

quotes.quote: God doesn't bless us just to make us happy; He blesses us to make us a blessing.
quotes.author: Warren W. Wiersbe

quotes.quote: Think of the patience God has had for you and let it resonate to others. If you want a more patient world, let patience be your motto
quotes.author: Steve Maraboli,  Unapologetically You: Reflections on Life and the Human Experience

quotes.author: Georges Duhamel

quotes.author: Leigh Bardugo,  Six of Crows

That's the only means that occurs to you: a strict secular police force, and the threat of punishment by an all-seeing God for whatever the police overlook. You sell human beings short.
quotes.author: Carl Sagan,  Contact

quotes.quote: ...Christianity will go. It will vanish and shrink. I don't know what will go first, rock 'n' roll or Christianity. We're more popular than Jesus now. Jesus was all right, but his disciples were thick and ordinary. It's them twisting it that ruins it for me.
quotes.author: John Lennon

quotes.quote: Myth is what we call other people's religion.
quotes.author: Joseph Campbell

quotes.quote: I held my heart back from positively accepting anything, since I was afraid of another fall, and in this condition of suspense I was being all the more killed.
quotes.author: Augustine of Hippo,  Confessions

quotes.author: John Ortberg Jr.,  The Me I Want to Be: Becoming God's Best Version of You

quotes.quote: There is no God, Nature sufficeth unto herself; in no wise hath she need of an author.
quotes.author: Marquis de Sade

quotes.quote: the church should just stay out of people's pants.
quotes.author: Alex Sanchez,  The God Box

quotes.author: Dan Brown,  The Lost Symbol

quotes.quote: Waking up is not a selfish pursuit of happiness, it is a revolutionary stance, from the inside out, for the benefit of all beings in existence.
quotes.author: Noah Levine

quotes.quote: The immature think that knowledge and action are different, but the wise see them as the same.
quotes.author: Anonymous,  Bhagavad Gita: El Canto del Senor

quotes.quote: When you look at the past without God's eyes, you subject yourself to deception. The past no longer exists and God doesn't linger there. quotes.author: Shannon L. Alder

quotes.author: Stormie Omartian,  Stormie: A Story of Forgiveness and Healing

quotes.author: G.I. Gurdjieff

quotes.author: Rich Mullins

quotes.author: John Fowles,  The French Lieutenant's Woman

quotes.author: Cormac McCarthy,  The Crossing

quotes.author: Ruth Hurmence Green

quotes.author: Florence Nightingale

quotes.quote: Mayonnaise: One of the sauces which serve the French in place of a state religion.
quotes.author: Ambrose Bierce

Just a few memorized formulas plus so-called intuition and so-called common sense.
quotes.author: Arkady Strugatsky,  Roadside Picnic

quotes.quote: Once you have surrendered yourself, you make yourself receptive. In receiving from God, you are perfected and completed.

quotes.author: George Carlin

quotes.author: Joseph Smith Jr.

quotes.quote: The danger is that in reaction to abuses and distortions of an idea, we'll reject it completely. And in the process miss out on the good of it, the worth of it, the truth of it.
quotes.author: Rob Bell,  Sex God: Exploring the Endless Connections Between Sexuality and Spirituality

quotes.quote: In the midst of the affliction He counsels, strengthens confirms, nourishes, and favors us.... More over, when we have repented, He instantly remits the sins as well as the punishments. In the same manner parents ought to handle their children.
quotes.author: Martin Luther

quotes.quote: Whole life is a search for beauty. But, when the beauty is found inside, the search ends and a beautiful journey begins.
quotes.author: Harshit Walia

quotes.quote: When we give up the chase, we give up our wishing.

quotes.quote: If merely 'feeling good' could decide, drunkenness would be the supremely valid human experience.
quotes.author: William James

quotes.quote: Our identity rests in God's relentless tenderness for us revealed in Jesus Christ.
quotes.author: Brennan Manning,  Abba's Child: The Cry of the Heart for Intimate Belonging

quotes.quote: The Bible is the greatest of all books; to study it is the noblest of all pursuits; to understand it, the highest of all goals.
quotes.author: Charles C. Ryrie

quotes.quote: I believe that a godly home is a foretaste of heaven. Our homes, imperfect as they are, must be a haven from the chaos outside. quotes.author: Jani Ortlund

quotes.quote: God takes away the minds of poets, and uses them as his ministers, as he also uses diviners and holy prophets, in order that we who hear them may know them to be speaking not of themselves who utter these priceless words in a state of unconsciousness, but that God himself is the speaker, and that through them he is conversing with us.

quotes.quote: If God sends us on strong paths, we are provided strong shoes.

quotes.quote: As the fear of God is the beginning of wisdom, so the denial of God is the height of foolishness.

quotes.author: Anonymous

quotes.quote: If goodness has causes, it is not goodness; if it has effects, a reward, it is not goodness either. So goodness is outside the chain of cause and effect.
quotes.author: Leo Tolstoy,  Anna Karenina

quotes.quote: I'm an atheist, and a militant atheist when religion starts impacting on legislation.

quotes.quote: The faith of religion is belief on insufficient evidence.

quotes.quote: Religion is the opium of the poor
quotes.author: Ernest Hemingway

quotes.quote: Pray to God, but row towards shore.
quotes.author: Lee Ezell

quotes.quote: Whatever negative things people think and say about you is enough to bring you down provided you belief that it carries a weight that can push you hard. Don't agree to accept what critics say; be prepared to silence them by doing what they think you can't do!
quotes.author: Israelmore Ayivor,  The Great Hand Book of Quotes

quotes.quote: The split in America, rather than simply economic, is between those who embrace reason, who function in the real world of cause and effect, and those who, numbed by isolation and despair, now seek meaning in a mythical world of intuition, a world that is no longer reality-based, a world of magic.
quotes.author: Chris Hedges,  American Fascists: The Christian Right and the War on America

quotes.quote: I have been called arrogant myself in my time, and hope to earn the title again, but to claim that I am privy to the secrets of the universe and its creator - that's beyond my conceit.
quotes.author: Christopher Hitchens

quotes.quote: salvation is for the feeble, that's what I think. I don't want salvation, I want life, all of life, the miserable as well as the superb.
quotes.author: Tom Robbins,  Jitterbug Perfume

quotes.author: Max Lucado,  Traveling Light: Releasing the Burdens You Were Never Intended to Bear

quotes.quote: A pure heart is superlatively rare and even more attractive.

quotes.quote: Spirituality exist in testing and experiencing the depth of inner peace consistently.

The reality is that God's way is love, and you can see this for yourself.

The best he could gather was that Jesus lived long ago, told people to be nice, and they killed him for it. At the end, he asked who was Jesus' necromancer and if he was in the Bible, then Kaldar couldn't stop laughing and had to sit down.

quotes.quote: I guess if I had to pick a spiritual figurehead to possess the deed to the entirety of Earth, I'd go with Buddha, but only because he wouldn't want it.
quotes.author: Sarah Vowell,  Unfamiliar Fishes

quotes.quote: Men are free when they are obeying some deep, inward voice of religious belief. Obeying from within. Men are free when they belong to a living, organic, believing community, active in fulfilling some unfulfilled, perhaps unrealized purpose. Not when they are escaping to some wild west. The most unfree souls go west, and shout of freedom.
quotes.author: D.H. Lawrence,  Studies in Classic American Literature

quotes.quote: The soul ... has a slow and dark birth, more mysterious than the birth of the body. When the soul of a man is born in this country there are nets flung at it to hold it back from flight. You talk to me of nationality, language, religion. I shall try to fly by those nets.
quotes.author: James Joyce,  A Portrait of the Artist as a Young Man

quotes.quote: The five points of yama, together with the five points of niyama, remind us of the Ten Commandments of the Christtian and Jewish faiths, as well as of the ten virtues of Buddhism. They are the foundation stones without which we can never build anything lasting. (127)

quotes.quote: Our vision is so limited we can hardly imagine a love that does not show itself in protection from suffering. The love of God is of a different nature altogether. It does not hate tragedy. It never denies reality. It stands in the very teeth of suffering.

quotes.quote: Be content not with your lot in life but with being here in the flow of life. The glories of creation are in your very cells; you are made of the same mindstuff as the angels, the stars, and god himself.
quotes.author: Deepak Chopra,  The Book of Secrets: Unlocking the Hidden Dimensions of Your Life

quotes.quote: to have faith is precisely to lose one's mind so as to win God.
quotes.author: SÃ¸ren Kierkegaard,  The Sickness Unto Death

quotes.quote: The Bible makes it clear that every time that there is a story of faith, it is completely original. God's creative genius is endless.
quotes.author: Eugene H. Peterson

quotes.quote: Any patch of sunlight in a wood will show you something about the sun which you could never get from reading books on astronomy. These pure and spontaneous pleasures are 'patches of Godlight' in the woods of our experience.

quotes.quote: We must transcend the illusion that money or power has any bearing on our worthiness as children of God.
quotes.author: Steve Maraboli,  Life, the Truth, and Being Free

quotes.quote: Look, I know you meant well creating the world and all, but how could you let it get away from you like this? How come you couldn't stick with your original idea of paradise? People's lives were a mess.
quotes.author: Sue Monk Kidd,  The Secret Life of Bees

quotes.quote: Before you came into my life, I believed that God had abandoned me.Now I know that He has blessed me beyond measure. -sir Bannor-
quotes.author: Teresa Medeiros,  Charming the Prince

quotes.quote: Women are delicate creatures. Fragile. Gentle. Made by God to be sheltered from the harshness of this world..Morgan MacDonnell

quotes.quote: Those with less curiosity or ambition just mumble that God works in mysterious ways. I intend to catch him in the act.

quotes.quote: Are you asking me if there is a god?' he said, still in that soft voice. 'All I can say is, I believe there is. I feel him when I sing. He has responded to my prayers countless times. He guides my actions and he dwells in my heart. I know he is there.

quotes.quote: Marriage isn't about Winning - It's about Lasting
quotes.author: Mark Gorman

quotes.quote: We have very little faith in the Lord, very little trust. If we trusted the Lord as much as we trust a friend when we ask him to do something for us, neither we as individuals nor our whole country would suffer so much.
quotes.author: Thaddeus of Vitovnica,  Our Thoughts Determine Our Lives: The Life and Teachings of Elder Thaddeus of Vitovnica

quotes.quote: Do what you do only for God's sake, start for God's sake, work for God's sake, and act within the sphere of God's good approval.
quotes.author: Said NursÃ®

quotes.quote: ... one flaw throws the loveliness of [everything else] into focus. I remember reading that Shakers deliberately introduced a mistake into the things they made, to show that man shouldn't aspire to the perfection of God. Flawed can be more perfect than perfection.
quotes.author: Gretchen Rubin,  The Happiness Project: Or Why I Spent a Year Trying to Sing in the Morning, Clean My Closets, Fight Right, Read Aristotle, and Generally Have More Fun

quotes.quote: While you are going through your trial, you can recall your past victories and count the blessings that you do have with a sure hope of greater ones to allow if you are faithful.
quotes.author: Ezra Taft Benson

quotes.quote: What was the opposite of linkage blindness? What described being certain of something without any kind of evidence?...The term was faith.
quotes.author: Barry Lyga,  I Hunt Killers

quotes.quote: Everyone knows that God protects drunkards and lovers.
quotes.author: Alexandre Dumas,  The Three Musketeers

quotes.quote: Souls reconstructed with faith transform agony into peace.
quotes.author: Aberjhani,  The River of Winged Dreams

quotes.quote: You cannot exalt God and yourself at the same time.
quotes.author: Rick Warren

quotes.quote: May you live in such a way that your death is just the beginning of your life.
quotes.author: Max Lucado,  Outlive Your Life: You Were Made to Make A Difference

quotes.quote: You can have Jesus in your spirit and have an outrageous mess in your soul, and if you don't know what that's called, it's called religion.
quotes.author: Joyce Meyer

quotes.quote: Saying someone is religious is heard in most of America as a compliment, a reassuring affirmation that someone will be moral, ethical, and after a few glasses of wine, a freak in the bedroom.
quotes.author: Bill Maher,  When You Ride Alone You Ride With Bin Laden: What the Government Should Be Telling Us to Help Fight the War on Terrorism

quotes.quote: That which is impenetrable to us really exists. Behind the secrets of nature remains something subtle, intangible, and inexplicable. Veneration for this force beyond anything that we can comprehend is my religion.
quotes.author: Albert Einstein

quotes.quote: Any faith that admires truth, that strives to know God, must be brave enough to accommodate the universe.
quotes.author: Carl Sagan,  Contact

quotes.quote: That's the funny thing about religion: it doesn't matter what you say, you're going to upset someone.
quotes.author: Lewis Black,  Me of Little Faith

quotes.quote: If I am going to be drowned--if I am going to be drowned--if I am going to be drowned, why, in the name of the seven mad gods who rule the sea, was I allowed to come thus far and contemplate sand and trees?

quotes.quote: Unless you know where you are going then you will not know how to get there.
quotes.author: Stephen Richards

quotes.quote: AUM or Om is not related to any religion because Om was practiced before the birth of all the religions of the world.
quotes.author: Amit Ray,  Om Chanting & Meditation

quotes.quote: Why do we mortals wonder if it is through 'human chaos' or through 'divine perfection' when the world guides us to some magical event? In either case, is not the result the same? Is the result not 'divine perfection?
quotes.author: Roman Payne,  The Wanderess

quotes.quote: Science is observing truth in the light of head. Religion is observing truth in the light of heart. Humanity is using both the lights. And education is developing that humanity.
quotes.author: Amit Ray

quotes.quote: But what of faith? What of fidelity and loyalty? Complete trust? Faith is not granted by tangible proof. It comes from the heart and the soul. If a person needs proof of god's existence, then the very notion of spirituality is diminished into sensuality and we have reduced what is holy into what is logical.-Drizzt Do'urden
quotes.author: R.A. Salvatore,  Siege of Darkness

quotes.quote: Don't allow the opinions of other people to shape your concept of him. Get to know him yourself, and let the goodness of God change you from the inside out.
quotes.author: Judah Smith,  Jesus Is: Find a New Way to Be Human

quotes.quote: Daughter, we didn't need your note - or a prince's visit - to tell us you'd done nothing wrong. We know the daughter we raised. We fear for your future, but never for your character. You take our love and our trust wherever you wander. Father.
quotes.author: Gail Carson Levine,  Fairest

quotes.quote: The difference between faith and insanity is that faith is the ability to hold firmly to a conclusion that is incompatible with the evidence, whereas insanity is the ability to hold firmly to a conclusion that is incompatible with the evidence.
quotes.author: William Harwood,  Dictionary of Contemporary Mythology

quotes.quote: Do you think I care if Aslan doomes me to death?' said the King. 'That would be nothing, nothing at all. Would it not be better to be dead than to have this horrible fear that Aslan has come and is not like the Aslan we have believed in and longed for? It is as if the sun rose one day and were a black sun.
quotes.author: C.S. Lewis,  The Last Battle

quotes.quote: Have patience. All things are difficult before they become easy.
quotes.author: Saadi

quotes.quote: I don't think God wants to be worshiped. I think the only pure worship of God is by loving one another, and I think all other forms of worship became a substitute for the love that we should show one another.
quotes.author: Charles M. Schulz,  Charles M. Schulz: Conversations

quotes.quote: For years we've been telling God to get out of our schools, to get out of our government and to get out of our lives. And being the gentleman He is, I believe He has calmly backed out. How can we expect God to give us His blessing and His protection if we demand He leave us alone?
quotes.author: Anne Graham

quotes.quote: O God -- please give him back! I shall keep asking You.
quotes.author: John Irving,  A Prayer for Owen Meany

quotes.quote: The truth of our faith becomes a matter of ridicule among the infidels if any Catholic, not gifted with the necessary scientific learning, presents as dogma what scientific scrutiny shows to be false.
quotes.author: Thomas Aquinas

quotes.quote: You can't give somebody faith. They either got it or they don't.
quotes.author: Karen Marie Moning,  Iced

quotes.quote: The bird is gone, and in what meadow does it now sing?
quotes.author: Philip K. Dick,  Flow My Tears, the Policeman Said

quotes.quote: Hating skin color is contempt for God's divine creative imagination. Honoring it is appreciation for conscious, beautiful-love-inspired diversity.
quotes.author: T.F. Hodge,  From Within I Rise: Spiritual Triumph Over Death and Conscious Encounters with "The Divine Presence"

quotes.quote: Like most modern people, I don't believe in prophecy or magic and then spend half my time practicing it.
quotes.author: John Steinbeck,  The Winter of Our Discontent

quotes.quote: In the beginning Man created God; and in the image of Man created he him.
quotes.author: Jethro Tull

quotes.quote: There is no limit to the amount of intelligence invested in ignorance when the need for illusion runs deep.
quotes.author: Saul Bellow

quotes.quote: Fanatics can justify practically any atrocity to themselves. The more untenable their position becomes, the harder they hold to it, and the worse the things they are willing to do to support it.
quotes.author: Mercedes Lackey,  Changes

quotes.quote: Out of the cacophony of random suffering and chaos that can mark human life, the life artist sees or creates a symphony of meaning and order. A life of wholeness does not depend on what we experience. Wholeness depends on how we experience our lives.
quotes.author: Desmond Tutu

quotes.quote: I want to encourage you by letting you know that there's hope for you and your situation whatever you are dealing with. God is intimately involved with every detail of your future and His desire is for you to be an overcomer.

quotes.quote: I told him I had once lost everything I had, too, and that I think that can be God's way of building walls around us to force us to look up at Him.
quotes.author: Kimberly Novosel,  Loved

quotes.author: Bill Wilson

quotes.author: Shannon L. Alder

quotes.author: JosemarÃ­a EscrivÃ¡,  Christ Is Passing by

quotes.author: Karl Pilkington,  An Idiot Abroad: The Travel Diaries of Karl Pilkington

quotes.author: John Bytheway

quotes.author: George Weinberg

quotes.author: Christopher Pike,  The Red Dice

quotes.author: Stephen Richards

quotes.author: Gordon B. Hinckley

quotes.author: Robert A. Schuller

quotes.quote: We're stronger than we think.
quotes.author: Joe Kelly,  I Kill Giants

quotes.quote: Do not ask directions from the people around you. Ask directions from the person who called you.
quotes.author: Bo SÃ¡nchez

quotes.quote: He who has not God in himself cannot feel His absence.

quotes.quote: We were as Hansel and Gretel and we ventured out into the black forest of the world.
quotes.author: Patti Smith,  Just Kids

quotes.quote: Fear tries to get us to give up but faith takes us all the way through to victory
quotes.author: Joyce Meyer

quotes.quote: But what really matters is not what you believe but the faith and conviction with which you believe...
quotes.author: Knut Hamsun,  Mysteries

quotes.author: Mike Resnick,  The Outpost

quotes.quote: Churches thrive on martyrdom and persecution.

quotes.quote: Friends are the siblings God never gave us.
quotes.author: Mencius

quotes.quote: It is more Important to be of pure intention than of perfect action.
quotes.author: Ilyas Kassam

quotes.author: Abraham Lincoln

I had loved her before then, but like most young people, my affection was little more than a simple appreciation for the comforts and privileges most Americans enjoyed and took for granted. It wasn't until I had lost America for a time that I realized how much I loved her.
quotes.author: John McCain,  Faith of My Fathers: A Family Memoir

quotes.quote: What we call rational grounds for our beliefs are often extremely irrational attempts to justify our instincts.
quotes.author: Thomas Henry Huxley

quotes.quote: Are your convictions so fragile that mine cannot stand in opposition to them? Is your God so illusory that the presence of my Devil reveals his insufficiency?
quotes.author: Marquis de Sade

quotes.quote: God is the ultimate judge of what is truly in our souls. But we are requiered to forgive everyone.
quotes.author: Bree Despain,  The Dark Divine

quotes.quote: I am more afraid that this people have so much confidence in their leaders that they will not inquire for themselves of God whether they are led by him. I am fearful they settle down in a state of blind self security. Let every man and woman know, by the whispering of the Spirit of God to themselves, whether their leaders are walking in the path the Lord dictates, or not.
quotes.author: Brigham Young

quotes.quote: God takes everyone he loves through a desert. It is his cure for our wandering hearts, restlessly searching for a new Eden... The best gift of the desert is God's presence... The protective love of the Shepherd gives me courage to face the interior journey.
quotes.author: Paul E. Miller,  A Praying Life: Connecting with God in a Distracting World

quotes.quote: With my ninth mind I resurrect my firstand dance slow to the music of my soul made new.
quotes.author: Aberjhani,  Visions of a Skylark Dressed in Black

quotes.quote: To know much and taste nothing-of what use is that?
quotes.author: Bonaventure

quotes.quote: Do those people who hold up the Bible as an inspiration tomoral rectitude have the slightest notion of what is actually writtenin it?
quotes.author: Richard Dawkins,  The God Delusion

quotes.quote: I'm not out to disturb anybody's faith. I happen to be happy and comfortable with a belief system that has a dual deity and operates on a lunar schedule. It suits my needs. If you happen to be happy and comfortable with a belief system that features a single masculine deity and operates on a solar schedule, fine. I don't give a fat damn. What matters is what you do, not who's name you do it in.
quotes.author: Mercedes Lackey,  Burning Water

quotes.quote: For me, religion is like a rhinoceros: I don't have one, and I'd really prefer not to be trampled by yours.

quotes.quote: I need Christ, not something that resembles Him.

quotes.quote: religion is about having the right answers, and some of their answers are right... but i am about the process that takes you to the living answer... it will change you from the inside. there are a lot of smart people who are able to say a lot of right things from their brain because they have been told what the right answers are, but they don't know me at all.
quotes.author: Wm. Paul Young

quotes.quote: Without friends you have nothing!
quotes.author: Stephen Richards

quotes.quote: The true test of one's mettle is how many times you will try before you give up.
quotes.author: Stephen Richards

quotes.quote: The tragedy is that what you disapprove of in others is the very thing you disapprove of in yourself.
quotes.author: Stephen Richards

quotes.quote: Nobody understands the nature of the Church, or the ringing note of the creed descending from antiquity, who does not realize that the whole world once very nearly died of broadmindedness and the brotherhood of all religions.

quotes.author: Rumi

quotes.quote: All men are Prophets or else God does not exist.
quotes.author: Jean-Paul Sartre

quotes.quote: The goal of prayer is to live all of my life and speak all of my words in the joyful awareness of the presence of God.Prayer becomes real when we grasp the reality and goodness of God's constant presence with 'the real me.' Jesus lived his everyday life in conscious awareness of his Father.
quotes.author: John Ortberg Jr.,  The Me I Want to Be: Becoming God's Best Version of You

quotes.quote: Faith makes all things possible. Love makes them easy.
quotes.author: D.L. Moody

quotes.quote: if someone has just hurt you or broken your heart, if someone has just died, all the grace you need is there-waiting for you to receive it. As long as we are pulled inward-despair and self attention, we aren't free to reach for God's grace. If we mean to leave ourselves alone, we must keep a hand free.
quotes.author: Eugenia Price

quotes.quote: On my honor, I will do my bestTo do my duty To God and my country

quotes.quote: I see the glass half full and thank God for what I have.

We can pursue any question and can be sure that we will not fall off the end of the earth.

quotes.author: Aberjhani,  Elemental: The Power of Illuminated Love

quotes.author: Billy Graham,  Hope for Each Day: Words of Wisdom and Faith

quotes.author: Max Lucado

quotes.author: Criss Jami,  Diotima, Battery, Electric Personality

Pride is such a snake, and envy, and greed. Love, however, is a hoop, a wheel, that rolls on forever. We are rescued by those whom we have rescued. The saved become the saviors of their saviors.
quotes.author: Dean Koontz,  The Darkest Evening of the Year

quotes.quote: To me, God is like this happy bus driver.

quotes.quote: My God is love and sweetly suffers all.

quotes.author: Fyodor Dostoyevsky,  The Brothers Karamazov

quotes.quote: because it seemed too simple to accept that life was an act of faith.
quotes.author: Paulo Coelho,  Veronika Decides to Die

quotes.author: Sarah Ban Breathnach

quotes.quote: Every worldview has to bring together reason and faith.

quotes.author: Marquis de Sade

quotes.quote: <...> God is a person; godliness is a quality. You cannot become God, but you can be godly. <...>

quotes.author: James A. Murphy,  The Waves of Life Quotes and Daily Meditations

quotes.quote: Hope is faith holding out its hand in the dark.

quotes.quote: Because your steadfast love is better than life, my lips will praise you.

quotes.quote: What you cant forget... God cant remember!

quotes.author: Anonymous,  Holy Bible: King James Version

quotes.quote: The lust of the flesh directs these desires [of personal union], however, to satisfaction of the body, often at the cost of a real and full communion of persons.

quotes.quote: This is a God who is not identified with the help of a dictionary but through a relationship.

quotes.quote: We do know that no person can be saved except through Christ. We do not know that only those who know Him can be saved by Him.

Worse, she wondered to what ends people who believed these things would go to assert their views.
quotes.author: Robert Fanney

It is not in any sense a 'hypothesis.

quotes.quote: Something opens our wings. Something makes boredom and hurt disappear. Someone fills the cup in front of us: We taste only sacredness.

quotes.quote: Because God has made us for Himself, our hearts are restless until they rest in Him.
quotes.author: Saint Augustine

quotes.quote: 'Anyone who thinks sitting in church can make you a Christian must also think that sitting in a garage can make you a car.'
quotes.author: Garrison Keillor

quotes.quote: 'We are not necessarily doubting that God will do the best for us; we are wondering how painful the best will turn out to be.'
quotes.author: C.S. Lewis

quotes.quote: 'I believe in Christianity as I believe that the sun has risen: not only because I see it, but because by it I see everything else.'
quotes.author: C.S. Lewis
